**Who we are**


At Quokka, we believe that great technology starts with great people.  

People who are curious.  

People who care.  

People who enjoy learning, building, and creating things that matter.


We bring together specialists across embedded systems, digital solutions, and electrification to help our clients build products and experiences that make a real difference. Our values – **Care, Joy, Curiosity, Innovation** – guide how we work with each other and with our clients.  

  

Whether it’s code, hardware, design, or strategy, we’re here to make something meaningful together.

**Apply now!**


If this feels like the right place for you, we’d love to hear from you.  

We’re excited to get to know you!


Note, as part of our recruitment process, we conduct background checks on our final candidates. This is a standard step to ensure a safe and reliable hiring process for everyone involved.

title: Fullstack Developer
description:
Airpelago is the European leader in power line inspections using autonomous drones. Headquartered in Gothenburg, Sweden, we also have offices in Stockholm, England, France, and Germany.  With a flat organizational structure and a dynamic, curious team, we value creativity and problem-solving.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a Fullstack Developer at Airpelago, you will play a key role in advancing our products and systems. Your work will involve optimizing database queries, building new APIs, and developing scalable software solutions that our customers can directly engage with. This role offers the opportunity to independently drive changes from concept to completion, with support from the team.
   

  

 We are looking for someone who enjoys contributing broadly to the development process and can step in where needed. You will have the chance to take ownership and shape our technical solutions for end users.

title: Elixir Backend Software Developer – Stockholm, Sweden (On-site only, no relocation, no visa sponsorship)
description:
We welcome applications from both experienced developers and high-performing MSc students/recent graduates from KTH and other strong technical universities. Professional Elixir experience is not required for graduate candidates, but strong programming skills and a genuine interest in backend development and functional programming are expected.
 



  





 This is an on-site position in Stockholm – no remote work, relocation or visa sponsorship. Applicants must already live or study within daily commuting distance of Stockholm and already have the legal right to work in Sweden without current or future employer sponsorship. Please do not apply if you do not meet these requirements.
 



  





 Preferred start: as soon as possible. No cover letter is needed – apply with your CV and GitHub profile. Full-time candidates are prioritised, but part-time can also be discussed.
 



  





 Would you like to join Driftio's highly skilled team and build products using modern AI development tools and state-of-the-art security practices? We are looking for an open-minded developer, tester and problem solver with strong attention to detail and a product-oriented mindset. Although this role primarily focuses on backend development, an interest in the complete product experience and willingness to understand the frontend is valuable. We use agile development practices and contribute to open-source projects where appropriate.
 



  
 



 It is important that you share our ambition to help consumers gain more control over and value from their own data. We are looking for people interested in a long-term engagement and who are excited by the possibility of increased responsibility and potential future co-ownership as the company scales internationally.
 



  





 Our backend is built in Elixir for top stability, security and scalability. The code is modular using internal and external REST API:s for our SaaS subscription-based client iOS/Android apps and Web service. We are a team willing to use AI, learn about the latest tools as well as using established best practices based on security and efficiency, and we expect you to think in the same manner.
 



  
 



**Requirements** 




 Software development experience demonstrated through professional work, university coursework, thesis work, open-source contributions or substantial personal projects. For graduate candidates, strong university and personal projects can substitute for professional work experience
 



 Experience with SQL databases (PostgreSQL or MySQL preferred), REST APIs and cloud environments
 



 Experience with, or strong interest in, Elixir/Erlang and functional programming. Experience with Elixir, Erlang, Haskell or similar languages through professional work, university coursework, thesis work or personal projects is particularly valuable (professional Elixir experience is not required for graduate candidates)
 



 Linux/Unix-systems
 



 Some experience or familiarity with DevOps practices, cloud environments and deployment workflows
 



 Comfortable working with Git and collaborative software development workflows
 



 Highly motivated, self-driven and prepared to take ownership of challenging development tasks and important product milestones
 



 Currently living or studying within daily commuting distance of Stockholm and able to work from our Stockholm city office every working day and already legally authorised to work in Sweden without current or future employer sponsorship
 



 Speak and write English fluently
 



  
 



**Bonus qualifications** 




 Experience of modern front-end framework such as React, Angular, Vue or similar frameworks
 



 TypeScript/JavaScript, SCSS, HTML and Redux
 



 Effective use of modern AI coding tools such as Codex or similar tools
 



 Experience or strong interest in using LLMs/AI to improve software development, testing, code quality and developer productivity
 



 Experience with AI/LLM model optimisation
 



 Containers in cloud environment
 



 Google Cloud, AWS, Azure or similar cloud provider
 



 Agile/Scrum methodologies
 



 Microservices
 



 Good eye for design and easy to use functionality
 



 Speak and write Swedish fluently
 



                             
 



**Mindset and motivation** 




 Interested in a long-term journey helping build an ambitious, technology-driven fintech company in Stockholm and scale it internationally
 



 Comfortable joining an early-stage company where initial compensation may be below larger established technology companies and potentially participate in future co-ownership
 



 Motivated by building technology that can make a positive difference for consumers around the world
 



  





**Application** 




 Please send your CV, GitHub profile, links to software, university projects, thesis work or other technical projects you have personally developed, your current city of residence and your work authorisation status in Sweden to info@driftio.com. Students and recent graduates should also include their university, degree programme and expected or completed graduation date. Applications missing this information may not be considered. Grade credentials are a bonus. For any questions, please call Peter Montgomery directly at +46 70-865 05 65.
 



  
 



**About Driftio** 




 We are a small team sitting in the Stockholm Old Town (Gamla Stan) and are offering substantial value with AI technology for consumers and businesses with insights, or when consumers choose to share their own selected personal financial data. Value can mean savings and investment insights from family and friends, AI recommendations based on financial theory, or possibility to provide financial credibility enabling better deals in larger contracts (in for example an apartment rental contract) or purchase transactions (of for example a home or a car). Our vision is to help consumers globally to grow their wealth and to take better financial decisions. We are a GDPR-compliant European privacy-first app and web service but is completed to serve users globally.

title: Fullstack AI Engineer
description:
**Filed is building the first AI tax preparer trusted by America’s accounting firms.**
 Taxes might seem boring, but they are the $5 trillion backbone of the US economy. Globally, nearly $15 trillion in taxes is collected every year. Behind every dollar of it sits a professional making judgment calls, and the industry that does this work is breaking under a talent shortage no one has solved. We're fixing it. Today, hundreds of firms run Filed inside the systems they already use, and we're backed by Northzone, Neo, Analog, and Raine.
   

  

 This is an incredibly hard problem to build for. Tax professionals scrutinize technology intensely, and for decades no solution has reached their level of accuracy. Until now.
   

  

 What makes it hard is that tax is filled with subjectivity. General accounting can be binary, where the saying goes that "numbers don't lie". Tax runs on professional judgment. Give two tax professionals the same task and you can get two different results where no one is wrong. Both are correct. Harnessing AI for a world where multiple outcomes are correct in the eyes of the users creates a dimension of challenge few vertical AI companies ever face.
   

  

 In under two years, Filed has become the market leader in the space and is reaching escape velocity. It's now Filed vs. the incumbents.
   

  

 There has never been a more exciting time to work on a problem this complex. Join us while "I was there when it all started" is still true.
   

  

 Read more → TechCrunch
   

  

 ⸻
   

  

***What we should tell you about the role:***
 We're looking for a Fullstack AI Engineer who moves fast and thrives in high-velocity environments. You're the kind of person who sees a product gap, understands the root cause quickly, and ships a working feature in hours or days, not weeks. You love turning complex workflows into clean, intuitive interfaces, and you don't wait for a perfect spec to get started.
   

  

 You're a builder who's just as comfortable designing React UIs and TypeScript APIs as you are wiring up Python backends or deploying to Google Cloud or Azure. You sweat the details, but never let them block momentum.
   

  

 At Filed, engineering means more than owning the code. You own the outcome. You ship a feature, watch how CPAs use it, look at the metrics, and decide what the next version should be. Just you and your team, the data, and the user.
   

  

 As one of our core engineering hires, you'll help shape how tax professionals experience AI-assisted work end to end. You'll work closely with the AI, tax, and product teams - and most importantly, our users - to rethink what great AI native software can feel like.
   

  

 ⸻
   

  

**Here’s why this is a terrible job:**
* This is not a job for someone who likes to move slow.
* We operate week to week with ruthless speed. Sometimes we're going in the wrong direction, but more times than not we're going in the right direction.
* If you need a few extra days to polish a component, chances are there's already a handful of team members blocked behind you.
* You'll look at the usage data and figure out what to build next yourself.
* There are no clear answers. Just judgment calls, ambiguity, and constant input from every direction.
* You'll ask yourself, is this really the work? It is. And it's not for everyone.


 ⸻
   

  

**Here’s why it’s the best career choice you’ll make:**
* We're building what tax pros call impossible. A product that behaves like a teammate, not just another tool.
* We run reviews every 4 months. We operate with total transparency around pay, performance, and progress.
* You'll be paid above market. You'll earn equity that grows fast. And you'll have full autonomy to make high-impact decisions.
* You'll ship features because you believe in them, not because they got signed off.
* You'll talk to customer facing teams and will be exposed to customer feedback weekly. You'll drive outcomes end to end.
* We'll tell you what needs to be achieved. How you get there is on you.


 ⸻
   

  

**The teammate we’re looking for:**
* Thrives at solving hard product problems, not just technical ones
* Moves seamlessly between identifying problems, implementing solutions, and iterating quickly
* Excited by ownership - you want to be the person accountable for how a feature performs
* No lone wolves - we need a collaborative builder
* Big bonus if you've shipped product at a fast-moving startup before


 ⸻
   

  

**What you’ll be responsible for:**
* Building and maintaining fullstack features across our AI tax prep, planning, and review products
* Owning the UX and backend logic for the workflows tax professionals use every day
* Shipping fast, watching metrics, and deciding what to improve next - without being told
* You want to learn about LLMs and how to make them work for our customers to achieve higher accuracy and transparency
* Keeping the codebase clean, typed, and fast as we scale


 ⸻
   

  

**Your hard skillset:**
* Comfortable in TypeScript, React, and Python - you've built complex, data-heavy UIs and backend services before
* Familiar with cloud infrastructure on Google Cloud and/or Azure
* Bonus if you've worked in fast-paced startups or regulated industries
* Even bigger bonus if you've taken a product from 0 to 1 and watched real users depend on it


 ⸻
   

  

**Your soft skillset:**
* Comfortable being uncomfortable and making calls with incomplete data
* Empathetic and curious - building for the user, not just for clean code
* Highly collaborative across product, engineering, and tax
* Detail-oriented but pragmatic - you know when polish matters and when to ship
* You own your work and welcome the accountability that comes with it


 ⸻
   

  

**Growth and Levels:**
* We operate on six levels, from Level 1 to Level 6. Each reflects increasing ownership, impact, and scope with meaningful jumps in salary and equity.
* We review levels every 4 months. Promotions are based on output and ownership, not tenure.
* This isn't a comfortable CRUD role. It's fast, focused, and customer-obsessed.
* You will launch fast. You will learn fast. You will own what you ship.


 ⸻
   

  

**The process:**
* Quick intro call (30 minutes)
* Technical walkthrough and async task (60 minutes)
* Final round with our team (120 minutes)


 In just 3.5 hours, you’ll be wanting early access - just like the rest of our team - to get into the stack and start building a generational company, even before your first day. Because you’ll see the opportunity to change your career trajectory - fast.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
**About the role** 




 We're looking for hands-on Senior Fullstack Developers to join our mission of building the next generation of our B2B freight platform. As part of our ambitious tech team you'll work within a team led by a tech lead, collaborating closely with product owners, QAs, UX, and fellow developers to deliver scalable, reliable and user-focused solutions that create real value for our customers.
 



 In this role you'll take ownership of end-to-end development, from backend services and APIs to frontend experiences, and play a key part in delivering and improving our platform. You'll join a fast-moving environment where pragmatism, collaboration and clean engineering are what move us forward.
 



 This is a role for someone who enjoys building, iterating and solving real problems, not just talking about them.
 



  





**Key responsibilities** 



* Play a central role in designing, building, and shaping our new platform
* Develop scalable and efficient solutions using TypeScript and Node.js
* Design and implement REST APIs to power our platform's core features
* Work with modern frontend frameworks to deliver smooth user experiences
* Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high quality solutions
* Build automated tests to ensure performance, reliability and maintainability
* Contribute to technical discussions and help drive engineering best practices
* Stay on top of modern technologies and identify opportunities to improve our stack



  





**About you** 




 You're an experienced fullstack engineer who has worked effectively within teams and takes pride in delivering real value, not just shipping code. You thrive in a collaborative environment and aren't afraid to take ownership. You value simplicity, clean code and real impact. You enjoy working across the stack, are comfortable making sound technical decisions within an established architecture and take pride in delivering high quality solutions.
 



 You communicate clearly, enjoy working with others and are motivated by seeing your work make a difference, for both users and the team.
 



  





**We're looking for someone who has:** 



* A completed university degree of at least three years in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Systems Science or a related technical field (kandidatexamen or a five-year master's degree)
* At least 5 years of professional software development experience
* At least 3 years of professional experience building applications in TypeScript/JavaScript
* Strong proficiency in Node.js and Express.js
* Experience designing and implementing REST APIs
* Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (preferably AWS)
* Experience with at least one modern frontend framework (React, Svelte, Angular, Vue)
* Practical experience with SQL and NoSQL databases



  





**High value if you also bring:** 



* Production observability and monitoring (logging, metrics, tracing)
* Familiarity with CI/CD and containerization (Docker)



  





**About Zendr** 




 Zendr is a fast-growing SaaS company developing cloud-based solutions for B2B freight. We're an established business with a stable customer base relying on us every day, which gives us a solid foundation as we continue to scale. We're proud of our innovative platform, of the passionate team behind it, and of our commitment to making our customers' work easier. Collaboration and well-being are central to how we work, and we want you to feel valued, engaged, and able to influence our journey. At Zendr, you can grow quickly, both professionally and personally, while being part of building something meaningful.
 



  





**What we offer** 



* Direct impact on our core product, your work will shape the next generation of our B2B freight platform
* Work with a modern tech stack
* High ownership and autonomy in how you deliver, within a clear technical direction set by your team
* A culture where ideas are welcomed and your input truly matters
* Genuine room to grow, we invest in our people's development as the company scales
* A competitive salary tailored to your background, skills, and previous experience, along with a locally adapted benefits package designed to support your well-being and growth



  





**Our hiring process** 




 We respect your time and aim to make the recruitment journey fast, transparent and enjoyable:
 



  




* **Application review:** 
 We'll review your application promptly and get back to you within a few days.
* **First conversation:** 
 An informal video call to learn more about you and share who we are.
* **Coding assignment:** 
 A practical task to help us understand your technical expertise.
* **Technical interview:** 
 A meeting discussing the coding assignment to better understand your reasoning and decision making.
* **Final meeting:** 
 Meet the team, talk through the role in detail, and see if we're the right fit for each other.



  





 From first contact to final decision, you can expect clear communication, timely feedback, and respect for your time, because great talent deserves a great candidate experience.
 



  





**Additional information** 




 We review applications on a rolling basis and aim to get back to you promptly.
 



**Start date:** 
 As soon as possible
 



**Scope:** 
 Full-time, permanent position
 



**Location:** 
 Stockholm, Jönköping and Linköping

title: Core platform engineer!
description:
*På SET utvecklar vi autonoma UAV-förmågor där mjukvaran är den centrala värdedrivaren. Våra system gör det möjligt för en operatör att styra och koordinera flera autonoma plattformar samtidigt och används inom försvar och säkerhet där höga krav ställs på robusthet, säkerhet och tillgänglighet.*
 Vår mjukvaruutveckling är organiserad i
 **Capability Teams** 
 , som utvecklar operativa förmågor såsom autonomi, perception, navigation och strike, samt ett
 **Core Platform Team** 
 , som utvecklar den gemensamma mjukvaruplattform som hela produkten bygger på.
   

  

 Vi söker nu en
 **Core Platform Engineer** 
 som vill vara med och utveckla denna plattform.
   

  

 Som en del av Core Platform-teamet kommer du att arbeta nära vår mjukvaruarkitekt och övriga utvecklare för att bygga och vidareutveckla den tekniska grund som används av samtliga capability teams. Genom att skapa robusta, skalbara och återanvändbara plattformskomponenter ger du våra utvecklingsteam de bästa förutsättningarna att utveckla nästa generations autonoma system.
   

  

**Din roll**
 Du kommer att vara en central del av vårt Core Platform-team och utveckla den gemensamma mjukvaruplattform som ligger till grund för våra autonoma UAV-system.
   

  

 Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter är att:
   

  

* Utveckla den gemensamma mjukvaruplattform som används av samtliga capability teams.
* Utveckla gemensamma tjänster såsom loggning, konfiguration, diagnostik, systemövervakning och mjukvaruuppdateringar.
* Ansvara för paketering, installation och distribution av mjukvara till våra produkter.
* Vidareutveckla den Linux-baserade plattform som våra produkter bygger på.
* Säkerställa att plattformen är robust, säker, skalbar och enkel att vidareutveckla.
* Bidra till utvecklingen av våra Linux-baserade utvecklings- och produktionsmiljöer.
* Vidareutveckla automatiserade bygg-, test- och releaseprocesser.
* Utveckla och underhålla gemensamma utvecklingsverktyg och utvecklingsflöden.
* Arbeta nära capability teams för att förstå deras behov och omsätta dem i gemensamma plattformslösningar.


**Din profil**
 Vi söker dig som tycker om att bygga tekniska plattformar snarare än enskilda applikationer. Du motiveras av att skapa gemensamma lösningar som används av många utvecklare och som blir en central del av slutprodukten.
   

  

 Du har sannolikt flera års erfarenhet av att utveckla Linux-baserade mjukvarusystem och trivs med att arbeta i komplexa miljöer där kvalitet, robusthet och långsiktighet är avgörande.
   

  

 Du har god erfarenhet inom flera av följande områden:
   

  

* Linux och Linux-baserade produktplattformar
* Containerteknik
* Kubernetes
* Embedded Linux
* Programvaruarkitektur och modulära system
* Konfiguration och livscykelhantering av mjukvara
* Gemensamma plattformstjänster såsom loggning, diagnostik och systemövervakning
* Paketering, installation och distribution av mjukvara
* Git och moderna utvecklingsflöden
* Automatiserade bygg-, test- och releaseprocesser
* Python och/eller C++


 Det är meriterande om du även har erfarenhet av:
   

  

* Distribuerade system
* Robotik eller autonoma system
* Open source-utveckling
* Informations- och cybersäkerhet


 Som person är du strukturerad, nyfiken och lösningsorienterad. Du tycker om att bygga långsiktiga lösningar och uppskattar samarbetet med andra utvecklare för att skapa en plattform som gör hela organisationen snabbare, effektivare och mer robust.
   

  

 Vad vi erbjuder
   

  

* Möjlighet att utveckla den tekniska kärnan i nästa generations autonoma UAV-system.
* En mjukvarudriven organisation där plattformen är en strategisk del av produkten.
* Ett högkompetent team med korta beslutsvägar och stort eget ansvar.
* Stor möjlighet att påverka teknikval, arkitektur och arbetssätt.
* Arbete med avancerad teknik som används i verkliga tillämpningar inom försvar och säkerhet.
* En central roll i utvecklingen av framtidens autonoma autonoma system.

title: Nimbl söker Software Engineer i Stockholm
description:
**Bli en del av ett startup i Stockholm! Bygg backend-tjänster, API:er och molninfrastruktur med Python, Go, TypeScript och GCP.**
 Vill du vara med och bygga en ny teknisk plattform från grunden – där din erfarenhet inom AI gör skillnad? Här utvecklar du backend-tjänster, molninfrastruktur i GCP och lösningar med geospatial data och AI. Du arbetar i ett tekniskt produktteam där du driver lösningar från idé till produktion och bidrar till arkitektur, teknikval och produktutveckling.
   

  

**Vi erbjuder dig**
* Arbeta nära produkt och teknik i ett tidigt skede av plattformsutvecklingen
* Påverka arkitektur, tekniska beslut och hur lösningar implementeras
* Arbeta med AI
* Arbeta med en modern tech-stack: Python, Go, TypeScript, PostgreSQL/PostGIS, GCP, Docker och Terraform
* Samarbeta i ett litet team där kunskapsdelning och gemensamma beslut är centrala
* Kontor i centrala Stockholm med flexibel arbetsmiljö


**Det här gör du hos oss**
* Integrera och arbeta med ML/AI-pipelines och bildanalys via OpenCV
* Designa och bygga backend-tjänster och API:er i Python, Go och/eller TypeScript
* Modellera och optimera databaser i PostgreSQL med geospatiala data via PostGIS
* Bygga och underhålla infrastruktur som kod med Terraform på Google Cloud Platform
* Utveckla event-driven och serverless arkitektur i GCP
* Paketera och driftsätta tjänster med Docker och CI/CD-pipelines
* Ta tag i frontend när produkten kräver det
* Delta i code reviews och bidra till tekniska arkitekturbeslut


**Ditt team och arbetsplats**
 Du blir en del av ett mindre, högkompetent team i centrala Stockholm – där alla har en viktig roll i produktens framväxt. Vi jobbar i en modern miljö med tydligt fokus på teknik, snabb feedback och korta beslutsvägar. Du får de verktyg du behöver, både tekniskt och kreativt, för att kunna prestera och växa.
   

  

**Mer om dig**
 Vi söker dig som har erfarenhet av att utveckla lösningar där AI är en integrerad del av produkten. Du har arbetat praktiskt med AI/ML, exempelvis genom att integrera AI-modeller, LLM eller AI-tjänster i applikationer och produktionsmiljöer.
   

  

 Du Har Även Flera Års Erfarenhet Som Utvecklare Och Är Van Vid Att Bygga Och Vidareutveckla Moderna, Skalbara Lösningar. Vi Tror Att Du Har
   

  

* Erfarenhet av Python, Go eller TypeScript
* God förståelse för relationsdatabaser och SQL
* Erfarenhet av molnbaserad utveckling
* Vana av containerisering med Docker


 Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av PostgreSQL, geospatiala data och PostGIS samt Google Cloud Platform. Även erfarenhet av event-driven arkitektur, serverless-lösningar och Infrastructure as Code, exempelvis Terraform, är ett plus.
   

  

 Som person arbetar du självständigt och tar ansvar för att driva lösningar från idé till leverans. Du samarbetar nära teamet kring både produkt och teknik och är nyfiken på hur AI kan användas för att utveckla produkten och skapa nya lösningar.
   

  

**Så här får vi kontakt**
 I den här rekryteringen har vi valt att samarbeta med Ada Digital som strävar efter en transparent, inkluderande och snabbrörlig rekryteringsupplevelse. Vi vill veta mer om dig och din potential! Du söker tjänsten enkelt och behöver inte bifoga några dokument. Det räcker med en motivering till varför du söker tjänsten och om du saknar CV kan du bifoga din LinkedIn-profil. Följ sedan din ansökan live via vår hemsida. Urvalet sker löpande och tjänsten kan bli tillsatt före sista ansökningsdatum. Är du nyfiken och vill veta mer innan du söker? Hör av dig till ansvarig rekryterare. Vi ser fram emot att få kontakt med dig!

title: MACHINE LEARNING ENGINEER
description:
**Challenges you will work on**
 At SAS, machine learning has moved well beyond experimentation. As part of our ongoing Digital & IT transformation, we are expanding our investments in machine learning, automation, data platforms, and Generative AI. We design, deploy, and operate production models that support pricing decisions, personalize customer experiences, and make our operations smarter every day.
   

  

 As a Machine Learning Engineer, you will play an important role in developing, deploying, and maintaining machine learning solutions that create real business value. You will work closely with data scientists, data engineers, and AI engineers to help bring models from development into production and ensure they perform reliably at scale.
   

  

 If you're passionate about applying machine learning to real-world challenges and want to help shape the future of AI at SAS, this is the role for you!
   

  

 As our Machine Learning Engineer, you will help develop and operationalize machine learning solutions across SAS. In this role, you will work hands-on with deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement of production ML solutions.
   

  

 You will collaborate closely with data scientists to transition models from experimentation to production, help improve deployment processes and contribute to the ongoing development of our ML platform and engineering practices.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design, develop, test, deploy and monitor end-to-end pipelines for machine learning models in Azure.
* Apply MLOps best practices, including version control, continuous integration, continuous delivery, continuous training, testing, and monitoring, to ensure the quality and reliability of the machine learning solutions.
* Monitor model performance and help identify issues related to model quality, drift, and reliability.
* Support automation of model training, deployment, and retraining processes.
* Contribute to best practices for machine learning engineering, testing, documentation, and deployment.
* Work with Data Engineering and IT teams to ensure solutions are scalable, secure, and reliable.
* Help develop and improve CI/CD processes for machine learning applications.
* Participate in troubleshooting and resolving issues in production ML systems.
* Stay up to date with developments in machine learning, MLOps, and cloud technologies.


**The Team**
 We are a central AI & Automation function within SAS Digital & IT that develops and operates solutions across machine learning, automation, MLOps, and Generative AI. Our team consists of data scientists, AI engineers, ML engineers, and automation specialists who work together to deliver solutions that create measurable business impact.
   

  

 As SAS continues to strengthen its AI capabilities, we are investing in modern cloud platforms, scalable AI solutions, and engineering practices that enable machine learning to create value across the business.
   

  

 As part of the team, you will contribute to a growing portfolio of machine learning products and collaborate across disciplines to ensure solutions are production-ready, scalable, and valuable to the business.
   

  

**To be successful we believe you have**
* Master's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Machine Learning, Mathematics, or a related field.
* 2-5 years of experience in Machine Learning Engineering, MLOps, or a related role.
* Experience developing, deploying, and operating machine learning solutions in production environments.
* Hands-on experience with Azure ML, Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory, or similar cloud-based ML platforms.
* Proficiency in Python, SQL, Git, and Bash.
* Experience deploying and serving machine learning models through APIs, as well as monitoring model performance in production.
* Understanding of model evaluation techniques, hyperparameter tuning, and validation approaches such as back-testing.
* Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code, preferably Terraform on Azure.
* Solid understanding of software engineering practices, including testing, version control, and CI/CD principles.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to explain and document technical concepts clearly and effectively.
* Experience with Generative AI, LLMs, or AI agents is considered a plus.


 We believe you are a curious and pragmatic engineer who enjoys solving problems with data and machine learning. You are comfortable working across the ML lifecycle, from experimentation to production, and enjoy collaborating with colleagues from different disciplines.
   

  

 You are eager to learn, improve your technical skills, and contribute to building reliable AI solutions that create real business value. Most importantly, you understand that successful machine learning is not only about models, but about delivering solutions that work in the real world and continue to provide value over time.
   

  

**Why SAS?**
 Join SAS at an exciting time of technological transformation. Digital & IT is modernizing our technology landscape, strengthening cloud-native capabilities, and expanding the use of AI across the company. As a Machine Learning Engineer, you will work with modern Azure technologies, MLOps practices, and Generative AI while building solutions that support both customer experiences and critical airline operations.
   

  

**Benefits**
 At SAS, we offer extensive opportunities for professional development in an international, fast-paced working environment. We are dedicated to the continuous growth of our employees. Working with us comes with a variety of benefits, including:
   

  

* Travel Perks: Enjoy discounted travel opportunities around the world with SAS.
* Health & Wellness: Access to health and wellness benefits, including a newly renovated gym with complimentary classes such as CrossFit and yoga.
* Discounts: Receive discounts from a wide range of brands, as well as on transportation to and from airports, airport shops, hotels, and car rentals.
* Work Environment: Our office location in Frösundavik offers a vibrant workspace with a restaurant, café, and easy access to outdoor activities in Hagaparken and Brunnsviken. Engage in running, tennis, outdoor gym sessions, kayaking, and stand-up paddling with equipment available free of charge.
* Convenient Commute: Benefit from a non-stop bus service connecting our office to Solna station, and commuter trains, alongside a network of cycle paths.


**Our Culture at SAS**
 At SAS, we are dedicated to caring for each other, delighting our travelers, and driving the transformation towards sustainable aviation. As a future colleague on our team, you'll join a culture where we work collaboratively towards common goals, recognize each other's contributions, and celebrate successes. Our focus is on safe, sustainable, and punctual execution, and we are committed to protecting our planet while transforming SAS for the future. This is an empowering workplace where you can thrive, grow, and take ownership of your work. Join us at SAS and be part of shaping the future of aviation!
   

  

**Additional Information**
* Apply by September 4, 2026. We review applications continuously and encourage you to apply early, as the position may be filled before the closing date. Please note that, due to GDPR regulations, we cannot accept applications via email.
* This is a full-time position (100%) based at our headquarters in Frösundavik, Solna, Stockholm. We value in-person collaboration, although flexible working arrangements may be available depending on team and business needs.
* As this role contributes to security-classified systems and business-critical capabilities, a background check will be conducted as part of the final stage of the recruitment process.


 If you would like to learn more about the role, the team, or how AI, MLOps, and Generative AI are evolving at SAS, feel free to reach out to Warren Edgren, Head of AI & Automation, at warren.edgren@sas.se.
   

  

 Please note that applications must be submitted through our careers site, as we are unable to process applications received by email.

title: Frontendutvecklare
description:
**Vill du utvecklas som frontendutvecklare i ett erfaret team där du får både stöd och eget ansvar?**
 Gjensidige är ett av Nordens ledande försäkringsbolag och ett av de största bolagen noterade på Oslo Börs. Vi är verksamma i Sverige, Norge och Danmark och har cirka 4 000 medarbetare. I Sverige är vi omkring 280 medarbetare som arbetar för att skapa trygga och innovativa lösningar för våra kunder.
   

  

 Vi befinner oss på en omfattande teknisk utvecklingsresa där vi moderniserar våra system, vidareutvecklar våra digitala tjänster och bygger lösningar som ska hålla över tid. Nu söker vi en frontendutvecklare som befinner sig i början av sin karriär och som vill utvecklas tillsammans med ett etablerat och erfaret team.
   

  

**Om rollen**
 Som frontendutvecklare blir du en del av ett tvärfunktionellt utvecklingsteam där du arbetar nära andra utvecklare, designers, arkitekter och verksamhetsexperter.
   

  

 Ditt huvudsakliga fokus blir att underhålla och vidareutveckla React-applikationer som används av både kunder och medarbetare. Arbetet omfattar såväl ny funktionalitet som förbättringar av befintliga lösningar, exempelvis inom användarupplevelse, tillgänglighet, prestanda, testning och teknisk kvalitet.
   

  

 I utvecklingen använder vi Gjensidige Builders, vårt gemensamma designsystem med återanvändbara komponenter och riktlinjer för att skapa enhetliga och tillgängliga digitala tjänster.
   

  

**Du kommer bland annat att:**
* underhålla och vidareutveckla webbapplikationer i React och TypeScript
* omsätta design och verksamhetsbehov till användarvänliga och tillgängliga lösningar
* arbeta med komponenter och riktlinjer från vårt etablerade designsystem
* felsöka, förbättra och modernisera befintlig kod
* skriva tydlig, underhållbar och testbar kod
* delta i kodgranskningar och tekniska diskussioner
* samarbeta med designers, backendutvecklare, arkitekter och verksamhetsrepresentanter
* delta i hela utvecklingsprocessen, från analys och implementation till produktionssättning och uppföljning
* successivt ta ett större ansvar för lösningar och leveranser


**Stöd, lärande och eget ansvar**
 Vi förväntar oss inte att du ska kunna allt från första dagen. Du får en ordentlig introduktion, löpande stöd från erfarna kollegor och möjlighet till mentorskap och teknisk vägledning.
   

  

 Samtidigt lägger vi stor vikt vid ditt eget driv. För oss innebär det att du aktivt tar ansvar för din utveckling, söker information, ställer frågor, ber om återkoppling och driver dina uppgifter framåt inom tydliga ramar.
   

  

 Du kommer inte att lämnas ensam med svåra problem, men vi förväntar oss att du själv tar initiativ till nästa steg och använder det stöd som finns omkring dig.
   

  

**Vi vill att du**
* har en relevant utbildning inom systemutveckling, datateknik, IT eller motsvarande
* är nyutexaminerad eller har något eller några års erfarenhet av frontendutveckling
* har arbetat med JavaScript eller TypeScript genom studier, egna projekt eller arbete
* har erfarenhet av React eller ett tydligt intresse för att fördjupa dig inom React
* har grundläggande kunskaper i HTML och CSS
* har intresse för användarupplevelse, tillgänglighet och kvalitet
* kan ta ansvar för dina uppgifter och kommunicera när du behöver hjälp
* uttrycker dig väl på svenska och engelska


 Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av något av följande:
   

  

* automatiserade tester för frontend
* Git och kodgranskning
* designsystem eller komponentbibliotek
* webbtillgänglighet och WCAG
* integrationer mot API
* CI/CD och GitHub Actions
* egna projekt, praktik eller arbetslivserfarenhet inom webbutveckling


**Vem är du?**
 Vi söker framför allt en person med rätt inställning och utvecklingspotential.
   

  

 Du är nyfiken, ansvarstagande och tycker om att förstå hur saker fungerar. När du stöter på ett problem försöker du själv komma vidare, samtidigt som du vet när det är dags att fråga om hjälp. Du tar gärna emot återkoppling och använder den för att förbättra både ditt arbete och din kompetens.
   

  

 Du trivs med att samarbeta, delar med dig av det du lär dig och bidrar till ett öppet arbetsklimat där teamet löser problem tillsammans.
   

  

**Därför ska du välja Gjensidige**
 Hos oss får du möjlighet att:
   

  

* utvecklas tillsammans med erfarna utvecklare och arkitekter
* få mentorskap, teknisk vägledning och kontinuerlig återkoppling
* arbeta med moderna frontendtekniker i en etablerad organisation
* bygga vidare på ett välutvecklat designsystem och gemensamma tekniska principer
* arbeta med lösningar som används i verkligheten och skapar värde för många människor
* successivt ta större tekniskt ansvar i takt med att du utvecklas
* bli en del av en kultur som präglas av samarbete, tillit och lärande


**Arbetsplats:** 
 Stockholm
   

  

 Vill du ta nästa steg i din utveckling och vara med och vidareutveckla Gjensidiges digitala tjänster? Skicka in din ansökan senast den 13 september. Har du frågor kan du gärna ta kontakt med rekryterande chef Jan Österhus, Jan.Osterhus@gjensidige.no
   

  

 Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

title: ServiceNow Utvecklare
description:
*Vill du vara med och utveckla en modern ServiceNow-plattform som verkligen gör skillnad för verksamheten? Hos oss får du kombinera teknisk fördjupning med nära samarbete med beställare och användare i ett team som delar kunskap, stöttar varandra och vågar testa nytt. Här får du stort eget ansvar, möjlighet att påverka och utrymme att växa.*
**Om jobbet**
 I den här rollen blir du en central person i utvecklingen av vår ServiceNow-plattform. Du arbetar nära verksamheten för att omsätta behov till smarta, skalbara och säkra lösningar som stärker våra processer och stöttar affären. Du blir en del av ett framåtlutat och kompetent team bestående av utvecklare, business analyst, configuration manager, portal manager, produktägare och service portfolio manager – tillsammans driver ni plattformen framåt med fokus på stabilitet, användarvänlighet och ständig förbättring.
   

  

 Dina arbetsuppgifter kommer bland annat vara att:
   

  

* Ansvara för utveckling, anpassning och underhåll av ServiceNow-plattformen utifrån verksamhetens behov.
* Föra dialog med beställare och användare för att förstå behov, samla in krav och ta fram kravspecifikationer.
* Utveckla, konfigurera och implementera lösningar, applikationer, arbetsflöden och automatiseringar i ServiceNow.

* Testa, verifiera och driftsätta nya lösningar så att de uppfyller krav och inte påverkar befintlig drift negativt.

 Meriterande är även om du har:

 Som person är du analytisk, nyfiken och trivs med att lösa komplexa problem på ett strukturerat och noggrant sätt. Du är kommunikativ och samarbetar gärna med både tekniska och icke-tekniska kollegor, samtidigt som du är självständig och tar ansvar för att driva ditt arbete framåt. Du har ett starkt servicefokus och god förståelse för användarnas behov, är flexibel och anpassningsbar när förutsättningar förändras och motiveras av att leverera resultat med hög kvalitet. Hos oss kommer du att trivas om du uppskattar självledarskap, gillar att lära dig nytt och vill utveckla din fulla potential i ett team där alla stöttar varandras utveckling.
   

  

**Kontaktpersoner**
 Rekryterande chef: Farhad.Tabari@lansforsakringar.se

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
**About Enity Bank Group** 




 Since 2005, we’ve been challenging the Nordic mortgage market by thinking differently – and more inclusively. We exist for those who often fall between the cracks of the traditional banking system, offering sustainable and responsible mortgages that truly make a difference.
 



  





 Enity is a listed company with strong brands including Bluestep Bank, Bank2 and 60plusbanken. Together, we operate in Sweden, Norway and Finland, helping people enter the housing market, re-mortgage expensive debt, or save safely and smartly.
 



  





 At Enity, you’ll be part of challenging conventions, driving change, and creating real value. We believe that the combination of courage, care and innovation can create meaningful impact – both for our customers and for you as a colleague.
 



  





 Want to help shape the future of banking? You’ll feel right at home at Enity.
 



  





**About the role** 




 We are looking for a senior engineer with a strong backend profile to help us modernize banking technology and create seamless digital experiences for our customers. If you enjoy solving complex problems and working with modern tech stacks and are excited about leveraging AI in your everyday development, this could be the role for you.
 



  





**What you'll be doing** 




 As part of our cross-functional team, you'll design, develop, and maintain secure, scalable applications in a cloud-based, microservice-oriented environment. You'll collaborate closely with product owners, designers, and fellow engineers to continuously improve our platforms and deliver high-quality user experiences.
 



  





**Tech Stack** 




**We work in a modern .NET environment** 



* .NET and C# for backend development
* Microservices communicating via RabbitMQ and REST APIs
* Azure, Kubernetes, and Docker for cloud infrastructure
* GitHub and GitHub Actions for source control and CI/CD (currently migrating from Azure DevOps)
* Angular and TypeScript on the frontend (occasional interaction expected)
* AI-assisted development with GitHub Copilot and Claude Code as part of our everyday workflow



  





**About you** 




 More than anything, we're looking for the right person. Solid technical experience matters. You'll need a strong background in .NET, cloud (ideally Azure), and modern backend development. But for us the bigger signal is how you work and learn. You're the kind of person who wants to understand why something works, not just that it does. You have real drive: you spot problems and bring ideas forward instead of waiting for someone to assign them.
 



  





 You're already using AI in your daily development, or you're eager to figure out how to get the most out of it. You like sharing what you know, and you learn just as eagerly from others. You can explain technical decisions to product owners, designers, and other non-engineers in a way that lands, and you take feedback seriously when it comes back to you. Experience from financial services is a plus, but not required. The right mindset is.
 



  





**Why you’ll love working here** 




 You'll have ownership and impact across a broad range of applications and systems, not just one piece of the puzzle. As a challenger bank, decisions move faster than at the larger players, and engineers have a direct voice in how we build. We believe in an office-first culture, with the flexibility needed to balance work and life. You´ll get access to ongoing training and professional development, and you'll work on problems that matter, helping people that traditional banks too often leave behind.
 



  





**We offer** 




 Along with a competitive salary, we offer a comprehensive insurance and benefits package that includes health insurance, occupational pension, extra vacation days, parental leave pay, wellness benefits, lunch benefit, possibility for a bike benefit, and some flexibility to support your work-life balance. Join our team and enjoy not only a rewarding career but also the perks of being part of a supportive and inclusive workplace.
 



  





 For this position, we offer a monthly salary starting at SEK 50.000. However, we recognize that experience and unique expertise matter, so there is flexibility to offer a higher salary for the right candidate.
 



  





**Sound interesting?** 




 We would be happy to see your application as soon as possible as the selection is ongoing. Please note that a valid work permit for Sweden is required for this position.
 



  





**Also note that this recruitment is managed by our external partner Safemind. All applications are submitted via Safemind's application form when you click
 *Apply* 
 .**

title: AI Solutions Engineer - Vitamin Well Group
description:
***Vitamin Well Group***
*develops premium functional drinks, snacks and protein products designed for modern, everyday life and on-the-go consumption. Our portfolio includes Barebells, NOCCO and Vitamin Well. With over 750 employees and revenue of more than SEK 10 billion, we are present in over 50 markets, with our headquarters in Stockholm and local teams and partners around the world. Our growth is driven by a focus on building strong brands, creating products with uncompromising taste and clear functionality, and consistently raising the bar across our categories.* 




  





 We are looking for someone who wants to turn AI from new possibilities into solutions that people actually use. This is a hands-on role where you will work closely with both technology and the business, from identifying the right problems to solve to building, testing and scaling solutions that create tangible value.
 



  





**About the role** 




 As AI solution engineer, you will be the link between what AI can do and what the business actually needs. You will work with different teams to understand how they operate today, identify where AI can create value and then build and test solutions yourself.
 



 This is not a strategy-only role. You will work hands-on with AI, automation, data and development, driving initiatives from the initial idea through to implementation.
 



  





**Key responsibilities** 



* Identifying and prioritising AI opportunities across the organisation
* Analysing workflows and building AI-powered solutions, agents and automations
* Prototyping, testing and iterating solutions with real users
* Measuring impact and scaling successful solutions across teams and markets
* Evaluating new AI models, tools and technologies and translating them into practical business applications



  





 We see programming as a craft. We are therefore looking for someone who enjoys building, testing and iterating solutions themselves rather than simply describing what should be done. You will be part of a small team building the technical foundation for Vitamin Well Group's next phase of digital development. The team works across areas including e-commerce, internal tools, data and AI.
 



  





 You will also work closely with commercial, operational and functional teams across the organisation. This means moving between different types of problems and business contexts. We work in short iterations and start from real business needs. When an idea shows potential, the goal is to quickly move from prototype to something people actually use.
 



  





**Who you are** 




 You have a few years of relevant experience within AI, automation, data, software development or a related field, and enjoy turning ideas into practical solutions. You are curious and hands-on, comfortable working at the intersection of technology and business, and enjoy understanding how things work and where there are opportunities to improve. You take ownership of your work and enjoy collaborating with different teams and stakeholders.
 



  





**To succeed in this role, we believe you have** 



* Hands-on experience with AI, automation, data, software development or similar technologies in a business context
* Experience with LLMs, AI tools and workflow automation
* Experience building AI agents, agentic workflows or AI orchestration
* Experience building or implementing AI-powered solutions used by real users
* Strong analytical, communication and problem-solving skills, combined with a proactive approach and sense of ownership



  





**It is a plus if you also have** 



* Strong skills in Python and SQL, as well as experience with APIs, integrations and data
* Experience evaluating different LLMs, AI models or APIs
* Experience with fine-tuning, inference optimisation or reasoning techniques



 Experience with modern data platforms, cloud environments or scaling AI solutions across an organisation
 



  





**How to Apply** 




*Application deadline: September 14th 2026* 




 We review applications on an ongoing basis and may fill the position before the application deadline. We appreciate LinkedIn, but to get a full picture of your experience, we ask you to also include a CV.
 



  





**Life at Vitamin Well Group** 




 At Vitamin Well Group, we believe that a great workplace fuels great products. With over 750 employees worldwide, our people play an important role in how we build brands, develop products and grow the business. Our values – innovation, courage, drive and responsibility – shape how we work together and how we do business.
 



 Across functions and markets, our teams are hands-on in building our brands, developing our products and making them available to consumers around the world. We embrace an office-first principle because we believe our best ideas emerge when people come together, share ideas, build relationships and take ownership.
 



 Promoting active lifestyles is part of our culture. Employees can take part in run clubs, group workouts, races and sporting events that suit different interests and fitness levels. As we continue to grow, we aim to make a positive impact by reducing our environmental footprint, promoting active and healthy lifestyles, and acting responsibly across our value chain.
 



*As part of the recruitment process, we may ask you to conduct a personality test as well as a test that measures logical ability. The purpose of the tests is to evaluate candidates as objective as possible and identify the best possible match for the role. The tests are based on solid research and are taken through our partner Alva Labs.*

title: Embedded Systems Engineer
description:
**Context**
 TERASi builds compact E-band wireless communication systems for defense, telecom, and industrial markets. The electronics team covers RF design and architecture, embedded hardware and PCB design, and lab testing. We are now bringing embedded software fully in house. This person will own embedded software development and system integration across the product range, and will build and lead the embedded systems team as the company grows.
   

  

**Why Join Us Now**
 Terasi is at an inflection point — we have real defence, telecom, and industrial customers waiting on systems we're actively building out, and the embedded software layer is being built from the ground up, right now. This isn't a role where you inherit a mature codebase and patch around the edges — you'll be the one defining the architecture, the conventions, and the team itself, from day one. High stakes, fast pace, and a small team means your work will directly shape nearly everything that ships. If you want outsized influence over how a defence-tech hardware company's software gets built — and the chance to grow into leading that function as we scale — this is about as good a moment as it gets.
   

  

**The Role**
 Own embedded software development for the product range. Immediate work: firmware development within the RU1's FreeRTOS architecture, contributing to architecture decisions as the system evolves, and developing the higher level gimbal control software — pulling data from the drone flight controller and gimbal IMU, processing it, and commanding off-the-shelf gimbal motor controllers. The person develops, tests, and iterates this software hands-on in the lab, working closely with the hardware engineers, and is expected to take ownership and drive work forward independently.
   

  

**Must-haves**
**What We're Looking For**
* 5+ years working at the intersection of embedded software and hardware, with the ability to independently debug and validate hardware in a lab environment — comfortable bringing up boards, working through hardware-software integration issues, and troubleshooting at the bench
* Expert embedded C/C++
* RTOS-based firmware development, ideally FreeRTOS: task design, timing, interrupt handling
* Microcontroller programming on modern platforms (RP2350, ESP32 or similar)
* Serial protocols in practice: UART, I2C, SPI, debugging on real hardware
* Motor control or motion systems experience: closed-loop control, IMU data processing, commanding motor controllers
* Solid working proficiency in Python — comfortable writing scripts and tools for test automation, data processing, and lab debugging
* Practical, hands-on experience with Linux
* Self-directed: identifies what needs doing and takes action


**Nice-to-haves**
* Experience with networking protocols and stacks on embedded systems (e.g., TCP/IP, Ethernet drivers), including bring-up and debugging of network connectivity on custom hardware
* Drone or flight controller ecosystem experience (e.g. MAVLink)
* Interest in growing into a technical lead role as the team expands


**What You Won't Need To Own**
 PCB design, power delivery, and embedded hardware are covered by the embedded electronics engineer. RF design and architecture sit with the senior RF engineer. Production test software has a dedicated owner. This person is the software and system integration counterpart to the hardware team, so clear interfaces and communication with the hardware engineers matter.
   

  

**Practicalities**
 Role is on site at the lab.
   

  

 TERASi is a deeptech startup based in Stockholm, Sweden which offers unique components and packaging for high-frequency wireless applications.
   

  

 TERASi’s technology builds upon academic research at KTH Royal Institute of Technology and years of internal R&D. The company designs and manufactures all components from its Stockholm headquarters and now embarks upon a mission to scale their technology and bring it to mass markets.

title: COBOL-utvecklare Handelsbanken Stockholm
description:
**Utveckla affärskritiska COBOL-lösningar på Handelsbanken i Stockholm – arbeta med filintegration i en komplex miljö.**
 Här jobbar du med något som faktiskt måste fungera. Varje sekund. Året runt. Du kliver in i ett team som ansvarar för bankens filintegrationer – flöden som kopplar ihop system över hela verksamheten och hanterar miljontals filer varje år. Det är stabilt, komplext och en förutsättning för att banken ska fungera i vardagen. Du kommer ha en central roll i förflyttningen, där en ny filintegrationsplattform byggs upp parallellt med att ni förvaltar och utvecklar det som redan finns. Här bidrar du både med att förstå det som finns idag och med att forma det som kommer framåt. Det här är en roll för dig som trivs i komplexa miljöer, gillar att förstå hur saker faktiskt hänger ihop – och vill vara med när något stort byggs om, samtidigt som det som finns behöver fortsätta fungera.
   

  

**Vi erbjuder dig**
 Här får du arbeta nära kärnan av bankens system, i en miljö där din kompetens verkligen gör skillnad.
   

  

 Det Här Är En Roll Där Du Både Får Förvalta Något Som Är Affärskritiskt Och Vara Med i En Långsiktig Teknisk Förflyttning. För Att Konkretisera
   

  

* Arbeta med system som hanterar miljontals filer och är centrala för hela banken
* Vara med i en modernisering av filintegrationsplattformen över flera år
* Få stort ansvar i ett område där stabilitet och kvalitet är avgörande
* Arbeta i ett erfaret team med djup kompetens och nära samarbete
* En trygg arbetsgivare med långsiktiga satsningar och låg riskprofil


**Det här gör du hos oss**
 Du blir en del av ett team inom filintegration där utvecklare, systemspecialister, produktägare och team coach arbetar nära varandra i vardagen.
   

  

 Teamet är erfaret, med kollegor som arbetat länge i både COBOL och bankens miljöer. Här finns en prestigelös kultur där man hjälps åt och delar kunskap. Ni samarbetar tätt med ett systerteam inom samma område, samt med andra delar av banken – allt från utvecklingsteam till drift och verksamhet. Totalt stöttar ni hundratals system i banken.
   

  

 Du utgår från Stockholm, med flexibilitet i vardagen beroende på situation och behov.
   

  

**Ditt team och arbetsplats**
 Du blir en del av ett team inom filintegration där utvecklare, systemspecialister, produktägare och team coach arbetar nära varandra i vardagen. Teamet är erfaret, med kollegor som arbetat länge i både COBOL och bankens miljöer. Här finns en prestigelös kultur där man hjälps åt och delar kunskap.
   

  

 Ni samarbetar tätt med ett systerteam inom samma område, samt med andra delar av banken – allt från utvecklingsteam till drift och verksamhet. Totalt stöttar ni hundratals system i banken. Du utgår från Stockholm, med flexibilitet i vardagen beroende på situation och behov.
   

  

**Mer om dig**
 Du har arbetat med COBOL under några år och känner dig trygg i att navigera i komplexa system. Du är van att analysera, felsöka och förstå hur olika delar hänger ihop.
   

  

**Vi Tror Att Du**
* Har erfarenhet av COBOL-utveckling på z/OS
* Har arbetat med analys, design och test
* Har erfarenhet av förvaltning och vidareutveckling av befintliga system
* Har kunskap inom DB2, SQL och JCL
* Behärskar svenska och engelska i tal och skrift


 Det är ett plus om du har erfarenhet av REXX, ISPF eller har arbetat inom bank och finans.
   

  

 Som person är du strukturerad och analytisk. Du trivs i komplexa miljöer där du får sätta dig in i hur system fungerar på djupet. Samtidigt är du nyfiken, ställer frågor och samarbetar gärna med andra för att hitta rätt lösning.
   

  

**Så här får vi kontakt**
 I den här rekryteringen har vi valt att samarbeta med Ada Digital som strävar efter en transparent, inkluderande och snabbrörlig rekryteringsupplevelse. Vi vill veta mer om dig och din potential! Du söker tjänsten enkelt och behöver inte bifoga några dokument. Det räcker med en motivering till varför du söker tjänsten och om du saknar CV kan du bifoga din LinkedIn-profil. Följ sedan din ansökan live via vår hemsida. Urvalet sker löpande och tjänsten kan bli tillsatt före sista ansökningsdatum. Är du nyfiken och vill veta mer innan du söker? Hör av dig till ansvarig rekryterare. Vi ser fram emot att få kontakt med dig!

title: Analytics Engineer
description:
**TL;DR** 
 - We are looking for analytics engineers to own the semantic and modeling layer of our warehouse by transforming raw data into well-defined, trustworthy datasets and metrics. You are obsessed with analytical consistency, designing impactful metrics, and building strong foundations for self-service analytics.
   

  

**Why Lovable?**
 Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.
   

  

 We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
   

  

 Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.
   

  

**What we are looking for:**
* Expertise with SQL, dbt, SQLMesh or similar tools (data modeling, testing, macros, docs)
* Experience with data warehousing concepts, cloud warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks) and BI tools (Looker, Tableau, Power BI, Hex, Metabase, etc)
* Understanding of dimensional modeling, data contracts, and metrics/semantical layers
* Familiarity with modern ELT and orchestration workflows (Airflow, Dagster, Prefect, etc)
* Strong business acumen and ability to translate domain logic into scalable data structures


**What you will do:**
* Build and maintain data models, following modular, tested, and version-controlled practices
* Partner with domain teams to understand business logic and codify it into reusable models and metrics
* Define and document key metrics and data contracts across domains
* Collaborate with Data Platform Engineers to optimize query performance and warehouse cost
* Automate and maintain data documentation, lineage, and governance standards
* Develop guidelines for analytics development, data modeling and structure conventions


**Our tech stack**
 We're building with tools that both humans and AI love:
   

  

* Frontend: React
* Backend: Golang and Rust
* Cloud: Cloudflare, GCP, AWS, Many LLM providers
* DevOps & Tooling: Github Actions, Grafana, OTEL, infrastructure-as-code (Terraform)


 And always on the lookout for what's next!
   

  

**How We Hire**
* Fill in a short form then jump on an intro call with recruiter.
* Complete the general programming exercise.
* Show us how you approach problems during several technical interviews.
* Tell us about your most impressive project.


**About Your Application**
* Please submit your application in English - it’s our company language so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join
* We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested please apply through our careers portal

title: Cloud Engineer with a passion for Data Engineering and AI-Data enablers | SEB, Solna
description:
Join our Data, Analytics and Reporting team to push us further working on or data platform.
   

  

 SEB is more than a bank. We are a technology-driven financial institution where everything starts from our customer needs and business outcomes. AI, data and modern engineering are natural parts of how we work, build and deliver value. From core banking platforms to agentic AI , automation, cybersecurity and cloud, we offer a broad tech landscape and many paths to grow. Together, we are shaping secure, responsible and future- proof solutions for our customers and society. Are you ready to take on a new challenge?
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are a cloud engineering team responsible for a wide range of data deliveries for reporting and analytical purposes, often driven by legal and regulatory requirements.
   

  

 We continue to build on our data platform in gcp including identifying ways to improve our analytics and reporting capabilities be it ai agents or any other automation or efficiency enablers. We also enable other teams on the platform to build their business data products within our domain.
   

  

 In this position You will regularly communicate and collaborate with colleagues in and out of the team. You will work on the agile ceremonies in the team and drive the PI planning together with our PO. You will design, build, and maintain scalable and reliable cloud-native data pipelines and platform capabilities on GCP. You will contribute to ingestion, orchestration, transformation, monitoring, and operational improvements across the platform, while helping ensure data quality, governance, and maintainability.
   

  

 The role also includes contributing to reusable engineering patterns, CI/CD and automation practices, observability improvements, and onboarding of new teams and consumers onto the platform.
   

  

 To thrive in this role, we believe you have
   

  

* Several years of experience in software or data engineering
* Strong proficiency in Python and SQL
* Experience building and maintaining scalable data pipelines
* Experience working with cloud-based data platforms (preferably GCP)
* Experience with orchestration or workflow tools (e.g., Airflow or similar)
* Understanding of modern data architectures (e.g., Data Warehouse, Data Lake)
* Proven experience working with CI/CD pipelines and Git-based development workflows
* A collaborative mindset and ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams
* Experience using LLMs as part of your development workflow, either professionally or through personal projects.


 Nice-to-have skills:
   

  

* Google Cloud Platform services such as BigQuery and Pub/Sub
* Containerization (e.g., Docker)
* Event-driven architectures and streaming data
* Advanced data modelling techniques (e.g., Dimensional Modelling, Data Vault)
* Data quality, monitoring, and observability practices
* IAM, secure access, and data governance principles
* Building robust and highly reliable data systems


 What we offer
   

  

* Working with skilled, caring, passionate and progressive team members
* Opportunities to help transform an industry
* Innovative company in forefront of technology
* Attractive compensation and benefits
* Access to SEB staff banking with exclusive benefits


 Do you want to be part of SEB?
   

  

 It is our fundamental belief that inclusion and diversity is crucial for our future success. We strive to have an inclusive, value-driven culture where employees feel valued, respected, and involved irrespective of who they are, what they believe or where they come from.
   

  

 Since we select candidates continuously, feel free to send in your application today via the link in this ad, but no later than
 **31-08-2026.** 
 We will not process applications via email.
   

  

 Please be aware that our final candidates undergo background checks, a process that includes for example identity control, verification of qualifications, credit checks, company engagements and history of crime. In some cases, we also apply random drug checks. During employment, employees within SEB can also expect to undergo recurring background checks.
   

  

 SEB Sweden has a redeployment responsibility, why this position might be covered by internal redeployment.
