title: People Tech Manager
description:
**About Us**
------------


Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.  

  

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.  

  

1,000+ customers across 50+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to **$100M+ in ARR**, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI and Graceview.  

  

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.  

  

Joining Legora means three things.

* We **lean in:** ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.
* We **fight for excellence:** high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.
* We **grow together:** as a team and with our customers.


Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.


If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

**The Role**
------------


Few companies at this stage have this much to re-design at once: rapid geographic expansion and starting multiple legal entities put demands on our People Tech function to keep the pace.


As People Tech Manager, you’ll work on the design, implementation, and scaling of the systems, tools, and data infrastructure that power our people operations as we grow.


Reporting to the People Tech Lead, you’ll work hands-on across our HR tech stack while partnering closely with People Enablement, IT, Finance, Legal, and business leaders. Our mission is to ensure our people infrastructure scales with the company, not lagging behind it.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Manage our people technology stack: HRIS, ATS, document management systems, and the cloud-based integrations that connect them.
* Configure systems for scalability, security, and regulatory compliance, anticipating future requirements before they become blockers.
* Maintain data accuracy, system reliability, and clear technical documentation, ensuring a single source of truth for our people data.
* Maintain and evolve integrations that create seamless, reliable data flows between systems.
* Ensure strong data governance, quality, and integrity across all people systems.
* Translate complex HR operations and regulatory requirements into scalable, system-driven processes that embed compliance by design while increasing operational velocity.
* Automate processes such as onboarding, offboarding, provisioning, approval chains, and lifecycle events. Design for self-service and track where things slow down or break.
* Enable the People team and managers to use systems by designing intuitive, user-centric processes and by designing & conducting training for non-technical users.
* Deploy and operate AI-enabled tooling to automate high-volume people processes such as ticket triage, document generation, and employee FAQs.
* Partner with the People function to identify where AI can ease their work, and enable them to adopt the right tools confidently through hands-on guidance, clear guardrails, and ongoing support.

**What You Bring**
------------------

* You’re a systems-oriented builder and a self-starter: when you encounter a manual process, you instinctively think about how it could be automated, standardised, or eliminated. You believe great people systems should be largely invisible, quietly enabling great work without creating friction.
* You balance technical execution with long term thinking. You’re comfortable configuring complex HRIS workflows and maintaining integrations, while planning for what the organisation will need at a significantly larger scale.
* You have 4+ years managing internal or people technology in high-growth environments, ideally at a company that has experienced rapid expansion.
* You have deep, hands-on experience with modern HRIS platforms and the broader HR technology ecosystem.
* You have the technical fluency to configure, maintain, and evolve cloud-based integrations and event-driven workflows.
* You are strong on stakeholder management and the ability to translate between technical and non-technical audiences.
* You are comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and iterating quickly.
* Experience with people analytics and dashboarding/reporting is a plus.
* Experience with building agents/agentic workflows as part of people processes is a plus.
* Hands-on experience with configurations in Hibob and Ashby is a plus.

**Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer**


At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Designledare (BIM & VDC) – PMO Sverige
description:
**Om tjänsten**
---------------


Roll: **Övriga tjänstemän**


Ansök senast: **2026-09-05**


Var: **Luleå**

  

**Designledare (BIM & VDC) – PMO Sverige**
==========================================


Digital samverkan, strukturerad design och effektiv informationshantering är avgörande för att lyckas i dagens komplexa bygg-, industri- och infrastrukturprojekt.


Bravida PMO Sverige söker nu en **Designledare (BIM & VDC)** som vill ta en central roll i utvecklingen av hur vi planerar, samordnar och genomför design och digital samverkan i våra projekt.


Hos oss får du möjlighet att arbeta i några av Sveriges mest omfattande projekt, där du tillsammans med projektorganisationen skapar struktur och arbetssätt som gör det möjligt att arbeta med rätt information, rätt versioner och rätt beslutsunderlag genom projektets olika skeden.


Du blir en viktig länk mellan projektets olika discipliner och bidrar till att omsätta kundens krav på VDC och digital samverkan till effektiva arbetssätt i projektet.


**Ditt nya jobb**


Som **Designledare (BIM & VDC)** ansvarar du för att leda och samordna designrelaterade aktiviteter och digital samverkan i projekt. Du arbetar nära projektledare, projekteringsorganisation, konsulter, entreprenörer och beställare för att skapa struktur, tydlighet och framdrift i designprocessen.


En viktig del av rollen är att säkerställa att projektet arbetar med **rätt information, rätt versioner och tydlig spårbarhet**. Du utvecklar och etablerar arbetsflöden som skapar kontroll över information och historik och som gör det enklare för projektorganisationen att fatta rätt beslut.


Du arbetar med digitala plattformar och verktyg för att skapa en gemensam informationsmiljö i projektet. **Autodesk Forma**, tidigare Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC), är exempel på en plattform som kan användas för informationshantering, dokumentation, samordning och digital samverkan genom projektets olika skeden.


Rollen innebär också att du driver VDC-relaterade arbetssätt tillsammans med projektets aktörer och bidrar till att utveckla PMO Sveriges förmåga inom digital design och samverkan.


**Dina huvudsakliga ansvarsområden**


* Leda och samordna designrelaterade aktiviteter genom projektets olika skeden.
* Säkerställa struktur, kvalitet och spårbarhet i design- och informationsflöden.
* Skapa och utveckla arbetsflöden för versionshantering, informationsstruktur och historik.
* Säkerställa att projektorganisationen arbetar med rätt information och aktuella underlag.
* Leda designrelaterade möten och samordningsaktiviteter mellan projektets olika discipliner.
* Samverka med projektledare, konsulter, entreprenörer och beställare för att skapa effektiva arbetssätt.
* Omsätta kundens VDC-krav till praktiska arbetssätt och processer i projektet.
* Bidra till att utveckla projektens digitala samverkan och användning av BIM som arbetssätt.
* Arbeta med och utveckla digitala informationsmiljöer, exempelvis **Autodesk Forma (tidigare Autodesk Construction Cloud/ACC)**.
* Identifiera förbättringsmöjligheter i design- och informationsprocesser och driva dessa tillsammans med projektorganisationen.
* Vara ett stöd för projektorganisationen i frågor som rör BIM, digital design, informationsflöden och VDC.
* Bidra till utvecklingen av PMO Sveriges standarder, processer och arbetssätt inom BIM och VDC.

**Vem är du?**


Vi söker dig som har erfarenhet av **BIM, designledning, digital samordning eller VDC** inom bygg-, industri- eller infrastrukturprojekt.


Du har ett genuint intresse för hur människor, processer och digitala verktyg kan samverka för att skapa bättre projektleveranser. Du trivs i en roll där du får skapa struktur, driva arbetssätt framåt och samordna flera olika aktörer och discipliner.


Du behöver inte vara den som själv projekterar. Det viktiga är att du förstår **designprocessen, informationsflödena och hur digitala arbetssätt kan användas för att skapa kontroll, kvalitet och effektiv samverkan.**


Du är en naturlig samordnare som bygger förtroende, tar initiativ och får människor att arbeta mot gemensamma mål.


**Vi ser gärna att du har**

title: Staff Data Scientist
description:
Are you ready to shape how Data Science influences company direction — not just individual team outcomes? Join Mentimeter as a Staff Data Scientist, a role that exists to help us identify, understand and act on the high-value opportunities where Data Science can shape where the company goes next.
  
The Catalyst department is on a mission to realise our company strategy and drive innovation, growth and impact across Mentimeter using data, automation and generative AI. In this role you'll turn ambiguous technical, behavioural, product, market and business signals into clear strategic opportunities, decisions and scalable analytical capabilities.
  
You'll operate confidently where the problem, ownership, approach or strategic implications are not yet clear, creating direction that enables Mentimeter to move from uncertainty to commitment and action. Working across Product Analytics and Revenue Analytics, your work won't just influence team and functional outcomes — it will help leaders make company-level decisions and raise the ambition of the entire Data Science craft.
  
Success looks like measurable company-level business impact, stronger strategic decision-making, and increased leverage from Data Science across Mentimeter. The strongest work here goes beyond delivering an analysis, model or framework — it changes what Mentimeter understands, prioritizes and decides to do.
  
What you’ll do
  
Identify and frame company-level opportunities where Data Science can create strategic leverage, and connect them to company strategy, growth, revenue, product outcomes and competitive advantage.
  
Lead complicated and complex Data Science initiatives that span functions or departments — from opportunity discovery and problem framing through to delivery, adoption and impact measurement.
  
Design, build and productionise statistical, predictive and algorithmic solutions — ML models, recommendation logic, customer and account scoring, segmentation, forecasting, experimentation and causal inference.
  
Help leaders make well-informed strategic decisions and trade-offs, making important trade-offs visible and helping Mentimeter commit to opportunities that may cut across departments or materially influence company strategy.
  
Define and raise the standard for how Data Science contributes to Mentimeter's strategy — best practices for modelling, code quality, deployment, monitoring, documentation, automation and responsible use of AI.
  
Build reusable models, methods and frameworks that increase the leverage of the craft, and mentor data scientists and cross-functional partners to raise the quality and impact of Data Science across the function.
  
Communicate complex analyses as clear narratives, trade-offs and recommendations that influence decisions across every level of the organisation.
  
  

We believe you have
  
A minimum of 12+ years of relevant experience in data science, analytics, machine learning or a closely related field, including a track record of leading initiatives end-to-end.
  
Problem formulation and strategic direction-setting — framing company-level opportunities where the problem, ownership or approach is not yet clear.
  
Strong business acumen — business sense, domain expertise and the ability to connect the dots between Data Science opportunities and strategic objectives across sales, product, revenue and growth.
  
Deep expertise in machine learning, statistics and causal inference, with strong proficiency in Python and SQL and solid software/ML engineering practices (git, code review, testing, versioning, monitoring, production-grade code).
  
Experimentation, measurement and decision science — building forecasting, measurement and analytical frameworks that improve decision quality.
  
AI/LLM building and emerging-technology judgement — evaluating new technologies (e.g. tools such as Cursor or Claude) and translating promising developments into concrete opportunities for Mentimeter.
  
Exceptional storytelling, communication and stakeholder management — turning complex, ambiguous information into clear narratives that influence senior stakeholders and company leaders.
  
Company-level influence and craft leadership — creating alignment across functions, mentoring others, and establishing reusable approaches and standards that outlast any single project.
  
An understanding of GDPR-sensitive data and data processing, with the judgement to know when to collaborate with legal experts on compliance assessments.
  
  

Nice to have
  
Familiarity with modern data tools such as Snowflake, Hex, dbt or similar.
  
Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS or Google Cloud.
  
Experience in a SaaS environment — especially enterprise go-to-market, revenue, customer lifecycle, product usage or retention data.
  
A history of influencing company-level priorities through data science, analytics or strategic insight work.
  
  

Not required
  
Swedish is not required — daily work is carried out in English, and the Mentimeter team currently boasts 50+ different nationalities.
  
A traditional cover letter is not required as part of your application.
  
  

**Location:**  

This is primarily an onsite role located at Mentimeter HQ in Stockholm, with a hybrid approach and ability to work from home up to twice per week.
  
Please note that we do not offer visa relocation sponsorship for this position.
  
  

**Our recruitment process:**  

Introduction interview
  
Competence interview, including a live case.
  
Personality & Logical ability test
  
Culture interview
  
References & Offer

* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence across technical and business functions.

title: Nattreceptionist Scandic No 25, deltid 83%
description:
Ansök nu
* Ansök senast: 3 september 2026
* Göteborg
* Arbete på plats
**Arbetsuppgifter**
-------------------

Scandic no 25, eller 25:an som vi brukar kallas, ligger precis vid Göteborgs centralstation med goda kommunikationer. Hotellet är personligt och hemtrevligt snarare än stort och pampigt. Det personliga formatet återspeglas också i stämningen bland oss som jobbar här- vi har en stark sammanhållning och hjälper varandra så ofta vi kan.


**Nu söker vi en Nattreceptionist till Scandic No 25.**



Oavsett varför gästen kommer till oss är det få saker som är så uppskattade som ett vänligt ansikte som hälsar välkommen. Du agerar värd tillsammans med övriga teamet på hotellet och skapar en gästupplevelse i världsklass.



Hos oss får du ta ett stort eget ansvar för att ta de beslut som krävs för att göra gästen nöjd och teamen utvecklar och förbättrar arbetssätt och service i takt med att omvärlden förändras. Vi är nämligen övertygade om att det är när du får utvecklas och bidra med all din kompetens och erfarenhet som vi överträffar gästens förväntningar. På köpet får vi kul på jobbet!



Så ta med dig dina erfarenheter, ditt engagemang och ditt sätt att tänka till oss – och bidra till en kultur där vi bryr oss på riktigt: om varandra, våra gäster och vår planet. Välkommen till Scandic!


**Vad är innebär rollen?**



Du som arbetar i receptionen är ansvarig för att våra gäster får service i världsklass. Du är spindeln i nätet som ser till att gästen alltid är i fokus. Du är den som går igenom ankomstlistan och lägger tid på detaljerna. Ser till att gästens önskemål uppfylls. Du har alltid ett leende på läpparna och en kreativ lösning i bakfickan. Du löser det mesta och är en stjärna på att vända en missnöjd gäst till en nöjd gäst. Din arbetsplats är vår lobby. För det är där du möter flest gäster. I ansvarsområdet ingår även administrativt arbete, säkerhetsarbete och arbete med försäljning.


Arbetet i receptionen innebär att checka in och ut hotellets gäster, hälsa välkommen och ge gästen den information den behöver om sin vistelse. Du hanterar bokningar i systemet Opera Cloud och hanterar administrativa uppgifter runt gäster och säkerhet. Allt arbete sker med gästnöjdhet och försäljning i fokus.


Hotellet har öppet dygnet runt och denna tjänsten är huvudsakligen på natten. Arbetspass på dagtid kan förekomma.


**Vem är du?**



För att passa i rollen tror vi att du har en väl utvecklad social förmåga och är kapabel att hantera att det händer många olika saker samtidigt. Det är mycket viktigt att du kan förmedla ett gott värdskap till hotellets gäster.



Du har också vana och kunskap i att arbeta med dator som arbetsredskap.


Eftersom arbetet till stor del består av att kommunicera med gäster är goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska en förutsättning. Talar du ytterligare ett språk är det meriterande.


Du är ansvarstagande, självgående och känner dig bekväm med att arbeta självständigt.



Allra viktigast är dock dina personliga egenskaper och din inställning. För att passa i rollen behöver du vara en lyhörd och prestigelös lagspelare som tar ett stort ansvar för dina arbetsuppgifter och helhetsresultatet.


**Information om tjänsten**



Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på deltid.


Vi tar enbart emot ansökningar via vår hemsida. Alla ansökningar kommer att behandlas löpande och tjänsten kan tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag, varför vi ber dig att ansöka så snart som möjligt. I denna rekrytering använder vi oss av ett enklare test om service vid urvalet.



Vi ser fram emot att välkomna dig till oss på Scandic!



Ps. på vår hemsida kan du läsa mer om vår kultur, vad tjänsten innebär och om våra förmåner!

title: MACHINE LEARNING ENGINEER
description:
**City:** Solna
  
Challenges you will work on
  
  

At SAS, machine learning has moved well beyond experimentation. As part of our ongoing Digital & IT transformation, we are expanding our investments in machine learning, automation, data platforms, and Generative AI. We design, deploy, and operate production models that support pricing decisions, personalize customer experiences, and make our operations smarter every day.
  
  

As a Machine Learning Engineer, you will play an important role in developing, deploying, and maintaining machine learning solutions that create real business value. You will work closely with data scientists, data engineers, and AI engineers to help bring models from development into production and ensure they perform reliably at scale.
  
  

If you're passionate about applying machine learning to real-world challenges and want to help shape the future of AI at SAS, this is the role for you!
  
  

As our Machine Learning Engineer, you will help develop and operationalize machine learning solutions across SAS. In this role, you will work hands-on with deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement of production ML solutions.
  
  

You will collaborate closely with data scientists to transition models from experimentation to production, help improve deployment processes and contribute to the ongoing development of our ML platform and engineering practices.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

Design, develop, test, deploy and monitor end-to-end pipelines for machine learning models in Azure.
  
Apply MLOps best practices, including version control, continuous integration, continuous delivery, continuous training, testing, and monitoring, to ensure the quality and reliability of the machine learning solutions.
  
Monitor model performance and help identify issues related to model quality, drift, and reliability.
  
Support automation of model training, deployment, and retraining processes.
  
Contribute to best practices for machine learning engineering, testing, documentation, and deployment.
  
Work with Data Engineering and IT teams to ensure solutions are scalable, secure, and reliable.
  
Help develop and improve CI/CD processes for machine learning applications.
  
Participate in troubleshooting and resolving issues in production ML systems.
  
Stay up to date with developments in machine learning, MLOps, and cloud technologies.
  
The Team
  
  

We are a central AI & Automation function within SAS Digital & IT that develops and operates solutions across machine learning, automation, MLOps, and Generative AI. Our team consists of data scientists, AI engineers, ML engineers, and automation specialists who work together to deliver solutions that create measurable business impact.
  
  

As SAS continues to strengthen its AI capabilities, we are investing in modern cloud platforms, scalable AI solutions, and engineering practices that enable machine learning to create value across the business.
  
  

As part of the team, you will contribute to a growing portfolio of machine learning products and collaborate across disciplines to ensure solutions are production-ready, scalable, and valuable to the business.
  
  

To be successful we believe you have
  
Master's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Machine Learning, Mathematics, or a related field.
  
2-5 years of experience in Machine Learning Engineering, MLOps, or a related role.
  
Experience developing, deploying, and operating machine learning solutions in production environments.
  
Hands-on experience with Azure ML, Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory, or similar cloud-based ML platforms.
  
Proficiency in Python, SQL, Git, and Bash.
  
Experience deploying and serving machine learning models through APIs, as well as monitoring model performance in production.
  
Understanding of model evaluation techniques, hyperparameter tuning, and validation approaches such as back-testing.
  
Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code, preferably Terraform on Azure.
  
Solid understanding of software engineering practices, including testing, version control, and CI/CD principles.
  
Strong communication skills and the ability to explain and document technical concepts clearly and effectively.
  
Experience with Generative AI, LLMs, or AI agents is considered a plus.
  
  

We believe you are a curious and pragmatic engineer who enjoys solving problems with data and machine learning. You are comfortable working across the ML lifecycle, from experimentation to production, and enjoy collaborating with colleagues from different disciplines.
  
  

You are eager to learn, improve your technical skills, and contribute to building reliable AI solutions that create real business value. Most importantly, you understand that successful machine learning is not only about models, but about delivering solutions that work in the real world and continue to provide value over time.
  
  

Why SAS?
  
  

Join SAS at an exciting time of technological transformation. Digital & IT is modernizing our technology landscape, strengthening cloud-native capabilities, and expanding the use of AI across the company. As a Machine Learning Engineer, you will work with modern Azure technologies, MLOps practices, and Generative AI while building solutions that support both customer experiences and critical airline operations.
  
  

At SAS, we offer extensive opportunities for professional development in an international, fast-paced working environment. We are dedicated to the continuous growth of our employees. Working with us comes with a variety of benefits, including:
  
  

**Travel Perks:** Enjoy discounted travel opportunities around the world with SAS.
  
**Health & Wellness:** Access to health and wellness benefits, including a newly renovated gym with complimentary classes such as CrossFit and yoga.
  
**Discounts:** Receive discounts from a wide range of brands, as well as on transportation to and from airports, airport shops, hotels, and car rentals.
  
**Work Environment:** Our office location in Frösundavik offers a vibrant workspace with a restaurant, café, and easy access to outdoor activities in Hagaparken and Brunnsviken. Engage in running, tennis, outdoor gym sessions, kayaking, and stand-up paddling with equipment available free of charge.
  
**Convenient Commute:** Benefit from a non-stop bus service connecting our office to Solna station, and commuter trains, alongside a network of cycle paths.
  
Our Culture at SAS
  
  

At SAS, we are dedicated to caring for each other, delighting our travelers, and driving the transformation towards sustainable aviation. As a future colleague on our team, you'll join a culture where we work collaboratively towards common goals, recognize each other's contributions, and celebrate successes. Our focus is on safe, sustainable, and punctual execution, and we are committed to protecting our planet while transforming SAS for the future. This is an empowering workplace where you can thrive, grow, and take ownership of your work. Join us at SAS and be part of shaping the future of aviation!
  
  

Additional information
  
Apply by September 4, 2026. We review applications continuously and encourage you to apply early, as the position may be filled before the closing date. Please note that, due to GDPR regulations, we cannot accept applications via email.
  
This is a full-time position (100%) based at our headquarters in Frösundavik, Solna, Stockholm. We value in-person collaboration, although flexible working arrangements may be available depending on team and business needs.
  
As this role contributes to security-classified systems and business-critical capabilities, a background check will be conducted as part of the final stage of the recruitment process.

Data Scientist Focused on Revenue Management & Network Optimization
  
  

At SAS, we're passionate about transforming aviation with cutting-edge technology. As part of our ongoing Digital & IT transformation, we are expanding our investments in AI, machine learning, advanced analytics, and data-driven decision-making to create smarter customer experiences and stronger commercial performance. You will work on one of the most challenging and rewarding problems in the industry: finding the right price, for the right customer, at the right time. Your work will ensure that the airline's Revenue Optimization remains scientifically robust, operationally scalable, and commercially impactful, directly shaping how revenue is optimized in a dynamic, competitive marketplace.
  
  

Your responsibilities will center on turning business challenges into well-defined analytical problems and building end-to-end machine learning solutions that deliver measurable impact. You will design, train, and maintain models that power SAS's revenue optimization, ensuring they are accurate, scalable, and production-ready.
  
  

A priority will be to deliver dynamic pricing, a groundbreaking shift in how SAS competes in the marketplace. At the same time, we are developing AI-driven revenue optimization at scale, ensuring our models continuously learn, adapt, and evolve with industry dynamics.

You will convert advanced research into production-ready optimization and modeling solutions, collaborating with the Operations Research team to embed novel algorithms into initiatives that deliver measurable business impact.

title: Data & BI Specialist for Marketing Domain
description:
**Job Description** **ABOUT THE TEAM**  

You'll join the Marketing Insights & Steering area within the Marketing Domain, where we enable data-driven decision-making across H&M's global marketing organisation. Our team plays a central role in understanding the impact of marketing, ensuring that investments across channels, markets and customer touchpoints are measurable, optimised and aligned with business goals.


We build and evolve the insights, measurement and reporting capabilities that help H&M understand how marketing drives customer behaviour and business results. By connecting data, technology and business needs, we enable smarter decisions and greater impact across the organisation.


Working closely with teams across Marketing, Marketing Tech and AI- Data & Analytics we help make trusted data more accessible and actionable across the business.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**  

As a Data & BI Specialist, you'll play a key role in transforming marketing data into actionable insights that shape decisions across H&M's global marketing organisation. Working at the intersection of business, analytics and technology, you'll help stakeholders understand performance, identify opportunities and make more informed decisions.


You will:

* Own and manage marketing reporting tools, ensuring they remain reliable, effective and aligned with business needs.
* Build, develop and improve data models, dashboards, reports and analytical solutions that support decision-making across Marketing.
* Translate business needs into scalable reporting solutions, intuitive visualisations and clear data requirements.
* Optimise existing data models and reports to improve performance, usability and business value.
* Identify opportunities to automate, streamline and simplify reporting processes to improve efficiency and consistency.
* Partner with business stakeholders to understand challenges, identify opportunities and turn data into actionable insights.
* Collaborate with data engineers, analysts and product teams to improve data quality, accessibility and governance.
* Support the development of self-service capabilities that enable teams to access insights and make informed decisions more independently.
* Contribute to the continuous development of H&M’s marketing data, reporting and analytics capabilities.

**WHO YOU ARE**  

You are curious, analytical and motivated by solving business problems through data. You enjoy working at the intersection of business and technology and know how to translate complex information into clear insights that drive action.


You thrive in collaborative environments and enjoy partnering with stakeholders across different functions. You are comfortable navigating ambiguity, asking questions and continuously looking for better ways to use data to create business value.

**WE ARE LOOKING FOR PEOPLE WITH**

* A degree in Analytics, Statistics, Economics, Engineering or another quantitative field.
* Experience within analytics, business intelligence, marketing analytics or a related field.
* Strong SQL skills and experience with Power BI, Tableau, Looker or similar visualisation tools.
* Experience working with large datasets from multiple data sources.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to explain complex concepts to non-technical audiences.
* Fluent English, written and spoken.

**IT'S A BONUS IF YOU HAVE EXPERIENCE WITH**

* Marketing and customer data.
* Google Cloud Platform, BigQuery or Databricks.
* Experience driving automation of analytical processes, reporting tools, and data models.

**WHY THIS ROLE IS EXCITING**


This role offers a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of marketing, analytics and business strategy. You'll help shape how H&M measures marketing performance globally and contribute to better decisions across media, customer engagement, brand building and commercial growth.You'll work with large-scale datasets, modern analytics platforms and stakeholders across one of the world's largest retail organisations, helping transform data into meaningful business impact.

 **Additional Information**  

This is a permanent full-time position based in **Stockholm.**


As collaboration and teamwork are important to us, we expect an **in-office presence** of four days per week.

**WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE**


At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer:

* Global career and development opportunities
* A value‑driven culture where you are encouraged to be yourself
* Staff discount cards and benefits
* Wellness and wellbeing benefits
* Parental support
* Opportunities to experiment, grow, and create tangible impact in a large‑scale tech organization.


Here, you are encouraged to be yourself, experiment, and grow — and as you flourish, so do we.


If you believe you can contribute to this role and want to join our team, we'd love to hear from you. Please submit your application in English.

*We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter to your application.*

title: System Engineer
description:
**System Engineer**

  

***At Icomera, we build technology that keeps people connected while*** ***they’re*** ***on the move. Every day, our solutions deliver fast, reliable internet and digital services on trains, trams, buses, and coaches - supporting millions of passengers across the world.***


***Do you enjoy working close to modern infrastructure platforms while ensuring stability, reliability, and operational excellence? We are looking for a System Engineer who combines strong operational expertise with a passion for automation, continuous improvement, and building resilient infrastructure services.***

  

**Job type****:** Full-time


**Workplace conditions****:**Hybrid

**Location****:**Gothenburg, Sweden

  

**About the** **Role**


You will become part of our IT Operations team and play a key role in ensuring the stability, availability, and continuous improvement of Icomera's infrastructure environments.

  

While the role is primarily focused on operating and maintaining server and infrastructure platforms, you will work closely with Cloud Platform Engineering, Networking Engineering, and Security teams to ensure that our services remain secure, observable, and capable of supporting both business operations and product development.

  

This is a hands-on technical role where you will contribute to everything from daily operations and system lifecycle management to automation initiatives that improve consistency, scalability, and reliability across our environments.

  

**Key responsibilities**


In this role, you will be responsible for maintaining and continuously improving the infrastructure that supports Icomera's business operations. You will ensure that our server and infrastructure environments remain stable, secure, and well-maintained throughout their lifecycle, while driving automation and operational improvements that increase reliability and reduce manual work. Working closely with Cloud Platform Engineering, Networking, Security, and external vendors, you will contribute to building a resilient and scalable foundation for the business.

  

**More specifically, you will:**


* Operate, maintain, and continuously improve server and infrastructure environments across on-prem and cloud platforms.
* Manage the infrastructure lifecycle, including installation, configuration, patching, upgrades, maintenance, and decommissioning.
* Monitor system health and performance, troubleshoot incidents, and contribute to reliable backup, recovery, and security practices.
* Develop and maintain automation, scripts, and tooling to improve efficiency, consistency, and operational quality.
* Collaborate with internal teams and external vendors on troubleshooting, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.
* Maintain technical documentation and operational runbooks.
* Participate in the IT Operations on-call rotation and support incident response.
**Re****quirements**


We're looking for someone with experience in systems engineering, infrastructure operations, or a similar technical role. You have a strong background working with Linux-based environments and enjoy troubleshooting, operating, and improving critical systems in production. You are comfortable working close to the technology and have experience with modern infrastructure environments, including cloud platforms such as AWS, containers, monitoring, and automation.

  

You also understand the importance of security, reliability, and operational excellence in business-critical environments.

  

**To succeed in this role, we also believe you have:**


* Experience with automation and configuration management tools such as Ansible, Terraform, or similar.
* Experience with at least one scripting or programming language, such as Python, Bash, or equivalent.
* A good understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP.
* Understanding of IT security principles and operational best practices.
* 5-8 years of relevant experience within systems engineering or IT operations.
* Formal education in IT, or equivalent professional experience.
* Fluency in English, both written and spoken.
**The following skills we see as meritorious:**


* Experience working in cloud and hybrid infrastructure environments.
* Experience implementing Infrastructure as Code and automation practices in production environments.
* Familiarity with database technologies such as PostgreSQL or MariaDB.
**Who You Are**


To thrive in this role, you are curious, hands-on, and motivated by solving technical challenges. You enjoy understanding how systems work together and take pride in creating stable and reliable infrastructure environments.

  

You work in a structured and methodical way, communicate clearly, and are comfortable documenting your work and sharing knowledge with others.

  

You remain calm under pressure, collaborate effectively across teams, and actively look for opportunities to improve systems, processes, and ways of working.

  

**Our Offer**


* + Health is important – we offer a comprehensive health promotion package to our employees
* + Flexible work arrangements – work from home for up to two days a week
* + Electrical bike lease agreement via net salary deduction
* + ITP Pension and collective bargaining agreement
* + A social work environment – board game nights, after works, seasonal parties… The list goes on!
  

***Practical details******:***


We will be reviewing applicants ongoing. Icomera welcomes candidates from all backgrounds, and we value a diverse and inclusive work environment.


We conduct reference checks and background checks as a standard procedure for all final candidates across all recruitment processes.


Icomera is covered by a collective bargaining agreement through TechSverige. Our local union representatives can answer questions related to the collective agreement and union matters at unionen@icomera.com or saco@icomera.com.

  

  

***About Icomera:***


Icomera is the world’s leading provider of integrated connectivity solutions for trains, trams, buses, and coaches, serving millions of passengers and tens of thousands of vehicles on a daily basis. The IcoCrew now consist of 300+ employees globally. Icomera is headquartered in Gothenburg, Sweden, with main offices in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, Germany, France, Ireland, and Italy.  

Icomera’s vision for green mobility within the public transport industry perfectly complements the wider mission of our parent company, Equans. As the global leader in multi-technical services with 74,000 employees working across 17 country hubs, Equans delivers customised solutions which connect, protect and energise territories, cities, buildings, industries and transport infrastructures, empowering their energy, industrial and digital transitions. Visit www.icomera.com for further information.

title: Lead Data Platform Architect to Alleima
description:

9 Sep
Country
Sweden
Location
Stockholm

R0040291
Job category

**At Alleima, data is a strategic asset and a key enabler for business performance, digitalization, and future innovation. We are building an Alleima Common Data Platform on Microsoft Fabric that will become a central foundation for trusted, scalable, and business-driven data across the company. When fully implemented, the platform will support analytics, reporting, and decision-making across key domains including Finance, Supply Chain, Production, Quality, and Sustainability.**


**This is an opportunity to take a central role in defining and evolving a platform that connects business needs, architecture principles, and hands-on technical realization. As our Lead Data Platform Architect, you will help shape how Alleima works with modern data architecture, reusable data products, and scalable analytics capabilities.**


**Data and AI are among the fastest-moving fields out there. What’s considered best practice today can become legacy tomorrow. Alleima works in a modern, fast-paced way, and we see AI as essential to working efficiently. We’re looking for someone who wants to keep pace with developments in an evolving technology landscape.**


Placement: Flexible within Sweden.


**About the role**


As Lead Data Platform Architect, you will define, lead, and realize the technical architecture for Alleima’s Common Data Platform on Microsoft Fabric. Working in close partnership with the Platform Owner, you will drive the end-to-end architecture and collaborate with domain data engineers, BI teams, enterprise architects, and solution teams.


You work both strategically and operationally, from defining target architecture, standards, and reusable patterns to supporting solution design, technical reviews, and complex design decisions in practice. The role also includes guiding platform evolution, enabling strong engineering practices, and ensuring that the Common Data Platform supports cross-functional analytics and decision-making across the company.


The platform journey is already underway, giving you the opportunity to influence its next phase and help turn emerging solutions into robust, reusable capabilities across Alleima.


**Key responsibilities:**


* **Own the end-to-end architecture** for the Common Data Platform, from source integration and ingestion to transformation, storage, semantic modeling, visualization, and analytics, and define the target architecture, reference patterns, and engineering standards that guide its evolution.
* **Lead the design and implementation of scalable data solutions in Microsoft Fabric**, using capabilities such as lakehouse and medallion patterns, notebooks, data pipelines, and semantic models.
* **Enable domain data engineers and BI teams to build high-quality solutions** by supporting the design and optimization of ETL/ELT pipelines, reusable information models, and analytics capabilities using SQL, Python/PySpark, and related technologies.
* **Establish strong engineering and governance practices** across the platform, including CI/CD, Git-based development, deployment, metadata, lineage, cataloging, and documentation, ensuring solutions are secure, standardized, reusable, and aligned with enterprise architecture and regulatory requirements.
* **Lead and coach data engineers, BI developers, and solution teams**, sharing best practices and helping teams make sound architectural and technical decisions while building strong capabilities across the organization.
* **Explore and evaluate new developments** in Microsoft Fabric, AI-assisted engineering, and the broader data ecosystem, bringing relevant capabilities into the platform where they create real value.

**About you**


We believe you hold a bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related field. You bring solid, hands-on experience from data platforms, analytics, data engineering, and architecture roles, and you are comfortable working across both strategic and hands-on responsibilities.  

  



You likely have a background as a Data Architect, Solution Architect, Lead Data Engineer, or similar. What matters more than years in the role is technical depth combined with real curiosity. You do not need to be an expert in every technology listed below. What matters most is deep experience in modern cloud data platforms and a strong understanding of data architecture and engineering.


You have strong experience with Microsoft Fabric and/or Databricks, Power BI and semantic models, Azure data platform services, and modern data engineering practices using SQL, Python, and PySpark.
  

You are familiar with ETL/ELT design, orchestration, CI/CD, Git-based development, integration patterns, and secure enterprise data platform design. Experience with Purview, Entra ID, Dataverse/D365 integrations, and Azure integration or cloud architecture patterns is considered a plus.


We see AI-assisted development tools, such as Copilot and LLM-based assistants, as a natural part of modern engineering. You actively use these tools in your work today and are interested in continuing to explore how they can strengthen engineering practices and create value.  

  



As a person, you are driven, curious, and collaborative, with the ability to coach others, challenge your own thinking, and keep learning as the field moves — you’re energized by staying at the front of it, not by having already arrived. You are fluent in English, and Swedish is a plus.
  

For this position, you need to be based in Sweden.  

  



**What you can expect from us**


* Be part of shaping Alleima’s modern data platform and analytics foundation in a strategically important role.
* Work in a position where you combine architecture leadership with practical technical influence across business-critical domains.
* Work closely with engaged stakeholders, architects, BI teams, and engineers, where you contribute your expertise, learn from others, and solve complex challenges together.
* Continue to grow through shared learning and complex challenges in Microsoft Fabric, enterprise architecture, analytics, governance, and modern data engineering.
* Contribute to a long-term platform journey that supports better decision-making, stronger data capabilities, and future digital ambitions across Alleima.
* Work in a fast-moving, modern engineering culture where AI-assisted tools are part of the everyday toolbox and help us work more efficiently and deliver high-quality solutions.

**Why Lovable?**
----------------


Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.


We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.


Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------


We’re looking for an **Analytics Engineer** with a background in Data Engineering or Analytics Engineering who operates as a true full-stack analyst, owning everything from raw data to insights to operationalization.


You bring:

title: Bachelor and master’s thesis degree project
description:
**Durée du contrat :**  

Orange Cyberdefense is Sweden’s leading cybersecurity company. We are seeking students for multiple research projects in a wide range of topics. Both Bachelor and Master-level students are welcome to apply. You are welcome to conduct your project either alone or in pairs or groups of students. Our three main areas of interest are:
  
* Cybersecurity, information security, and related topics
* Management, organization, and ethics
* Artificial intelligence


We have identified some initial research suggestions within these areas. However, we leave it up to the students themselves to choose and propose the specific research question to explore within these areas.
  
  

Cybersecurity, information security, and related topics
  
  

Cybersecurity and information security sits at the core of our business. As such, these topics are particularly salient for us at Orange Cyberdefense – and we are eager to enable research in this field. Some of our initial research suggestions include:
  
* Analyze the relationship between different regulatory frameworks in relation to a security issue. For example, how current EU legislation affects third-party risk management.
* How employee awareness and security training influence susceptibility to phishing and social-engineering attacks.
* Cybersecurity risk in cloud environments. For example, examine common security risks associated with cloud services and how organizations can mitigate them.


Management, organization, and ethics
  
  

Orange Cyberdefense is an international company with 400 employees in Sweden and 3000 colleagues across the globe. As such, we are happy to enable research on management and organizational topics. A global research angle is also possible here. Research suggestions include:
  
* Studying organizational cultures, strategies, and characteristics of different Orange Cyberdefense business units in different countries. Possibly in terms of AI usage.
* Comparing our management strategies with those of other cybersecurity companies.
* Customer excellence research project which analyses customer needs in relation to the services provided by Orange Cyberdefense.
* Analysis of relevant regulatory, financial, organizational, technical and logistical characteristics which face different customers in different sectors.


Artificial intelligence
  
  

Artificial intelligence is a key area of interest for us. We are very eager to proceed with a wide range of research projects on this topic. Some of our initial suggestions include:
  
* AI in phishing detection. Such as how phishing detection using linguistic and behavioral features compare to traditional classifiers.
* How attackers can manipulate inputs to evade AI-based intrusion detection systems.
* How large language models can identify and explain vulnerabilities.


Applying for a research project
  
  

Please apply by the ad. If you have more than one research idea, please include them all in one application. Make sure that your application reflects the following requirements:
  
* Include a short description of your proposed research, your area of interest, and clear suggestions for specific research question(s). It should be clear what you are interested in researching.
* Include initial suggestions for data collection- and analysis methods. Most importantly, describe what kind of data your project might need and from where you expect to collect it.
* Includes the full names of the participating student(s), what university you study at, if you are a bachelor or master’s student, and the approximate date your university expects you to start writing the thesis.
* The proposal does not exceed 1 page (or roughly 500 words) in length. If you want to propose more than one research idea, you may exceed this limit. However, please keep the length reasonably short.
* Make sure that everything is written directly in the email. Do not append your research proposal in a PDF or similar. Instead, write your text in the email itself.
* The subject/title of your email must begin with “Student Research Proposal: ”, followed by the name of your project. Example: “Student Research Proposal: Strategies for ethical AI use”


What if I want to propose an entirely new research idea?
  
  

You do not have to base your research proposal on our existing research suggestions. We are very happy to receive your very own research idea. If you want to put forward your own project proposal, please follow the steps listed above.
  
  

Requirements and information about the research opportunity
  
  

Your profile and the specific skills required will vary greatly depending on the nature of your research project. However, all candidates must live up to the following requirements.
  
* You are a bachelor or master’s student enrolled in a program at a Swedish University.
* You are fluent in English and Swedish.
* You are capable and willing to take the initiative and drive your research project forward.


Students are assigned to a research mentor at Orange Cyberdefense. Your mentor will help you define your research project, check in with you at regular intervals, and act as your go-between for reaching resources and employees within Orange Cyberdefense. Please note that students will not be able to conduct research projects that involve data from our clients. Due to the sensitive nature of Orange Cyberdefenses business, students will not be able to fully carry out their projects on-premise. At the onset of your research project, you and other students writing their thesis at Orange Cyberdefense are invited to our office for a kickoff meeting.
  
  

Rights and ownership over research results will belong to Orange Cyberdefense. As such, students are expected to sign a research project agreement before starting their project. Orange Cyberdefense does not provide monetary compensation for student research projects. However, we view these research projects as an organic way to get to know candidates for future roles.
  
  

We are Orange Cyberdefense
  
  

Orange Cyberdefense is Sweden’s leading cybersecurity company. Our vision is to help secure the digital society. We provide our customers with services across a wide range of areas, from advanced technical solutions to strategic services such as security governance, risk management frameworks, and risk assessments. We are 400 colleagues in Sweden and 3,000 colleagues globally.
  
  

Chez Orange, seules vos compétences comptent.
  
  

Quel que soit votre âge, genre, origine, parcours, religion, orientation sexuelle, handicap, neuroatypie, ou apparence, nous encourageons activement la diversité au sein de nos équipes, car elle constitue une force pour le collectif et un vecteur d’innovation.
  
  

**Orange est une entreprise handi-accueillante :** n’hésitez pas à nous faire part de vos besoins spécifiques.

description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


AWS Specialist Solutions Architects (SSAs) are technologists with deep domain-specific expertise, able to address advanced concepts and feature designs. As part of the AWS Specialist organization, SSAs work with customers who have complex challenges that require expert-level knowledge to solve. SSAs craft scalable, flexible, and resilient technical architectures that address those challenges.
  

  

Do you have the passion for helping customers and partners design and create robust security architectures to address their enterprise risk management requirements using cloud computing? Do you enjoy helping customers become more secure across their workloads and assisting them meet compliance accreditation? Would you like to do this using the world’s most advanced cloud computing technologies? Are you one of those rare technologists with the communication, consulting, and leadership skills to help guide major projects to success?  

In this role, you will deliver architecture guidance, lead proof-of-concept projects and conduct customer workshops. You will also drive collaboration with customers and partners to address security as well as compliance challenges.  

  

Your broad responsibilities will include: owning the technical engagement and ultimate success around specific implementation projects, working cross-organizationally to facilitate widespread use and adoption of the AWS platform (with security as Priority 1!), and developing a deep expertise in the AWS security technologies as well as broad know-how around how applications and services are securely constructed using the AWS platform. The ideal candidate will possess customer facing skills that will allow them to represent AWS well within the customer’s environment and drive discussions with senior personnel regarding trade-offs, best practices, and risk mitigation. They should also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically about business, product, and technology challenges.  

  

The Worldwide Specialist Organization (WWSO) is part of AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS), which is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector. We work backwards from our customers’ most complex and business critical problems to build and execute go-to-market plans that turn AWS ideas into multi-billion-dollar businesses. WWSO teams include business development, specialist and technical solutions architecture. As part of WWSO, you'll provide expertise across the entire life cycle of an AWS customer initiative, from developing ideas for new services to accelerating the adoption of established businesses. We pride ourselves on thinking big, delivering exceptional results for our customers, and working across AWS as #OneTeam.  

  

Are you passionate about cloud computing and its potential to overcome some of the biggest challenges? Do you have a unique combination of deep technical knowledge, business acumen, and strong interpersonal skills? Do you enjoy tackling large analytical problems as massive scale? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking a Senior Worldwide Specialist Solutions Architect focused on the Security domain to work with our customers.  

  

As a trusted customer advocate, you will help organizations understand best practices around Security and cloud-based solutions. You will have the opportunity to help shape and execute a strategy to build mind-share and broad use of AWS within enterprise customers. The ideal candidate must be self-motivated with a proven track record of customer obsession and delivering results. This role focuses on internal systems and corporate security architecture, including infrastructure, integrations, and third-party services. You will combine architectural thinking with hands-on expertise and act as a trusted partner to IT, Engineering, and business stakeholders.


You will have a direct impact on how we design, connect, and secure our systems as we continue to grow globally. This is a high-impact role for someone who understands modern digital environments and how to secure them end-to-end.


**What You Will Do** ***Internal Security & Risk***


* Lead security assessments of systems, integrations, and data flows
* Conduct technical risk analyses for system implementations and vendor onboarding
* Perform threat modelling and security reviews
* Define and implement security requirements for infrastructure and cloud environments
* Help establish and maintain security guardrails across identity, access, encryption, and integrations
* Proficiency in risk management
* Knowledge of emerging cybersecurity threats and trends

***Vendor & Third-Party Security***


* Define and enforce security requirements in procurement processes
* Conduct supplier security assessments and due diligence
* Evaluate third-party risks from a cybersecurity perspective

***Governance & Compliance***


* Maintain alignment with ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II
* Contribute to policies, standards, and security guidelines
* Support incident investigations

* 5+ years of experience in cybersecurity, information security, or a related field
* Strong technical foundation in cloud, networking, identity & access management, and system integrations
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
* Experience conducting technical risk assessments and security reviews
* Familiarity with ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II
* Ability to understand complex system landscapes and data flows
* Comfortable working cross-functionally with IT, Engineering, and Legal
* Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, or CISA are a plus
* Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field

**Who We’re Looking For** We’re looking for someone with a strong hands-on, doer mentality who is focused on getting things done and creating real impact. You are pragmatic, prestigeless, and motivated by outcomes. You thrive in dynamic environments where responsibilities are broad, and you feel comfortable navigating uncertainty and solving problems independently. You are curious by nature, proactive in your approach, and continuously looking to learn and improve both yourself and the way things are done.


**Why Tacton?**


* At Tacton, we’ve been building CPQ software for over 20 years. We’re a stable company with global customers and a product that’s central to how manufacturers sell

**This role is based in Stockholm, where we have invested in creating our unique home right next to Hötorget station.**

description:
**Description**
 Are you passionate about cloud technology and helping customers innovate?
   

  

 Join our AWS Solutions Architecture team in Sweden and empower Software, SaaS and Technology Companies to innovate at speed and scale with cloud technologies.
   

  

 Solutions Architects work hand in hand with AWS customers to help them make the most of the Cloud. They are at the crossroads of business and technology and engage with organizations at all stages of cloud adoption. Solutions Architects are responsible for creating and presenting technical content and sharing best practices.

They help customer's validate their initiatives from ideation to proof of concept. Solutions Architects lead activities such as architecture reviews, white-boarding sessions, demos and technical workshops. They collaborate with other teams such as account management, professional services, Industry experts, support, service teams and the AWS partner ecosystem.
   

  

 Amongst others you will be part of the design and building of reference architectures, proof of concepts and help customer deploy production workloads on AWS. You will also provide thought leadership and recommendations on cloud architecture, migration, modernization and operation.  We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

title: Lead Data Platform Architect to Alleima
description:
**At Alleima, data is a strategic asset and a key enabler for business performance, digitalization, and future innovation. We are building an Alleima Common Data Platform on Microsoft Fabric that will become a central foundation for trusted, scalable, and business-driven data across the company. When fully implemented, the platform will support analytics, reporting, and decision-making across key domains including Finance, Supply Chain, Production, Quality, and Sustainability.**
**This is an opportunity to take a central role in defining and evolving a platform that connects business needs, architecture principles, and hands-on technical realization. As our Lead Data Platform Architect, you will help shape how Alleima works with modern data architecture, reusable data products, and scalable analytics capabilities.**
**Data and AI are among the fastest-moving fields out there. What’s considered best practice today can become legacy tomorrow. Alleima works in a modern, fast-paced way, and we see AI as essential to working efficiently. We’re looking for someone who wants to keep pace with developments in an evolving technology landscape.**
 Placement: Flexible within Sweden.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As Lead Data Platform Architect, you will define, lead, and realize the technical architecture for Alleima’s Common Data Platform on Microsoft Fabric. Working in close partnership with the Platform Owner, you will drive the end-to-end architecture and collaborate with domain data engineers, BI teams, enterprise architects, and solution teams.
   

  

 You work both strategically and operationally, from defining target architecture, standards, and reusable patterns to supporting solution design, technical reviews, and complex design decisions in practice. The role also includes guiding platform evolution, enabling strong engineering practices, and ensuring that the Common Data Platform supports cross-functional analytics and decision-making across the company.
   

  

 The platform journey is already underway, giving you the opportunity to influence its next phase and help turn emerging solutions into robust, reusable capabilities across Alleima.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own the end-to-end architecture for the Common Data Platform, from source integration and ingestion to transformation, storage, semantic modeling, visualization, and analytics, and define the target architecture, reference patterns, and engineering standards that guide its evolution.
* Lead the design and implementation of scalable data solutions in Microsoft Fabric, using capabilities such as lakehouse and medallion patterns, notebooks, data pipelines, and semantic models.
* Enable domain data engineers and BI teams to build high-quality solutions by supporting the design and optimization of ETL/ELT pipelines, reusable information models, and analytics capabilities using SQL, Python/PySpark, and related technologies.
* Establish strong engineering and governance practices across the platform, including CI/CD, Git-based development, deployment, metadata, lineage, cataloging, and documentation, ensuring solutions are secure, standardized, reusable, and aligned with enterprise architecture and regulatory requirements.
* Lead and coach data engineers, BI developers, and solution teams, sharing best practices and helping teams make sound architectural and technical decisions while building strong capabilities across the organization.
* Explore and evaluate new developments in Microsoft Fabric, AI-assisted engineering, and the broader data ecosystem, bringing relevant capabilities into the platform where they create real value.


**About You**
 We believe you hold a bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related field. You bring solid, hands-on experience from data platforms, analytics, data engineering, and architecture roles, and you are comfortable working across both strategic and hands-on responsibilities.
   

  

 You likely have a background as a Data Architect, Solution Architect, Lead Data Engineer, or similar. What matters more than years in the role is technical depth combined with real curiosity. You do not need to be an expert in every technology listed below. What matters most is deep experience in modern cloud data platforms and a strong understanding of data architecture and engineering.
   

  

 You have strong experience with Microsoft Fabric and/or Databricks, Power BI and semantic models, Azure data platform services, and modern data engineering practices using SQL, Python, and PySpark.
   

  

 You are familiar with ETL/ELT design, orchestration, CI/CD, Git-based development, integration patterns, and secure enterprise data platform design. Experience with Purview, Entra ID, Dataverse/D365 integrations, and Azure integration or cloud architecture patterns is considered a plus.
   

  

 We see AI-assisted development tools, such as Copilot and LLM-based assistants, as a natural part of modern engineering. You actively use these tools in your work today and are interested in continuing to explore how they can strengthen engineering practices and create value.
   

  

 As a person, you are driven, curious, and collaborative, with the ability to coach others, challenge your own thinking, and keep learning as the field moves — you’re energized by staying at the front of it, not by having already arrived. You are fluent in English, and Swedish is a plus.
   

  

 For this position, you need to be based in Sweden.
   

  

**What You Can Expect From Us**
* Be part of shaping Alleima’s modern data platform and analytics foundation in a strategically important role.
* Work in a position where you combine architecture leadership with practical technical influence across business-critical domains.
* Work closely with engaged stakeholders, architects, BI teams, and engineers, where you contribute your expertise, learn from others, and solve complex challenges together.
* Continue to grow through shared learning and complex challenges in Microsoft Fabric, enterprise architecture, analytics, governance, and modern data engineering.
* Contribute to a long-term platform journey that supports better decision-making, stronger data capabilities, and future digital ambitions across Alleima.

title: Software Engineer
description:
**About the job** 

 At Capture Energy, we’re transforming our automation architecture and are looking for a
 
 Software Engineer – Operational Technology & Cloud Integration
 
 to build core services on our Capture Controller while ensuring seamless data flow to our cloud infrastructure.
 



  





 You’ll create lean, maintainable applications and clean interfaces between our operational technology and cloud systems.
 



  





 We primarily develop in
 
 Go
 
 , but we’re equally interested in strong
 
 Python engineers with BESS or energy experience
 
 who are willing to transition to Go. The right domain expertise, learning ability and hunger matter more than years on a resume.
 



  





 In this role, you’ll be a critical integration point between our automation systems and cloud platform, working closely with both our Senior TwinCAT Engineer and Cloud team to evolve our architecture.
 



  





**You Will** 



* Develop applications running on the Capture Controller to handle energy optimization, state management and control logic
* Communicate with TwinCAT via ADS (Automation Device Specification) to coordinate PLC operations and sensor data
* Design and implement data schemas and APIs for reliable, bidirectional data exchange between the controller and cloud services
* Architect a clean separation between real-time PLC functions and business logic in the controller application
* Work closely with both the TwinCAT engineer on the OT side and the Cloud team on the IT side to define data contracts and integration points
* Build robust error handling, logging and monitoring for production control systems



  





**We Expect You To** 



* Have solid production experience in
 
 Go or Python
 
 . You’ve shipped code that matters and understand what can go wrong in production
* Have strong systems-level thinking across state management, concurrency, real-time data handling and distributed systems
* Have hands-on experience with
 
 energy systems, BESS or battery management
 
 . This is critical and the hard part to teach
* Have experience with industrial protocols or hardware integration, even if not ADS specifically
* Be comfortable working across both operational technology (OT) and IT infrastructure layers
* Have a genuine curiosity about how things work and the drive to learn and ship in a fast-moving environment
* If Python is your primary language, have a demonstrated ability to learn new languages and a genuine interest in transitioning to Go as your primary development language
* Be fluent in English, both written and spoken
* Hold a valid visa permitting you to work in the EU.



  





**Nice To Have** 



* Existing Go experience
* Familiarity with Beckhoff TwinCAT or other PLC ecosystems
* Experience with ADS, OPC UA, Modbus, MQTT or similar industrial communication protocols
* Background in embedded systems, IoT or software running close to physical equipment
* Knowledge of battery energy storage, grid services, energy optimization or similar domains
* Experience with data pipelines, message queues or time-series databases



  





 This is a
 
 permanent full-time position based in Stockholm (Sweden) or Fredrikstad (Norway)
 
 , with an on-site setup and flexibility to work from home several days per week.
 



  





 For Python applicants transitioning to Go, you can expect structured onboarding with pair programming, mentoring and clear Go adoption milestones. We’ll invest in your ramp-up. In return, we ask that you commit to the transition.
 



  





 We offer competitive salary and benefits based on experience and location and are prepared to offer market rates for the right candidate in either Stockholm or Fredrikstad.
 




 Ready to apply?
 




  





**Send us your CV and a brief note about your experience with control systems, energy systems, cloud integration or similar production-critical development.** 




  





**If you’re a Python engineer, tell us about your learning track record and why you’re interested in Go.** 




  





**We look forward to hearing from you.**

title: Software Development Engineer – 2026
