title: AI Business Development Manager - EMEA/LATAM
description:
**Own Every Moment at NetApp**
 At NetApp, your ideas power innovation. We lead in intelligent data infrastructure—delivering unified storage, integrated data services, and solutions that help organizations unlock the full potential of their data, from AI to multicloud.
   

  

 Ready to innovate and contribute to our path to $10B? Here, you'll collaborate with passionate teams, tackle real-world challenges, and see your impact in how customers transform and grow. If you're ready to bring curiosity, creativity, and drive to every moment, NetApp is where your journey begins. Join teams that innovate to elevate, drive results, and excel together across every function.
   

  

 Job Summary:
   

  

 NetApp is uniquely positioned to help organizations unlock the value of AI through the data they already manage. With a significant share of the world's unstructured data residing on NetApp, we help enterprises and public sector organizations build and scale AI initiatives across training, inferencing, data pipelines, RAG architectures, sovereign AI platforms, and modern AI infrastructure.
   

  

 The AI Business Development Manager will be responsible for creating demand, generating qualified pipeline, and accelerating AI-related business growth across EMEA/LATAM. This is a highly strategic business development role focused on identifying opportunities, engaging customers and partners, and converting AI interest into measurable pipeline and bookings. Success is measured by pipeline creation, opportunity progression, and revenue impact.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities:
   

  

 Drive AI Pipeline & Growth
   

  

* Lead AI pipeline generation across EMEA/LATAM, creating qualified opportunities and driving business growth.
* Identify, prioritize, and engage target accounts using market insights, AI adoption trends, and installed-base opportunities.
* Partner with Sales, Marketing, and strategic partners to execute demand-generation activities that create pipeline and accelerate bookings.
* Build relationships with senior customer stakeholders and help shape AI strategies and opportunities.
* Expand AI adoption within existing customers and support acquisition of net-new AI-focused organizations.


 Develop AI Go-to-Market Strategy
   

  

* Develop and refine AI value propositions covering AI infrastructure, data pipelines, sovereign AI, inferencing, and emerging AI workloads.
* Build repeatable go-to-market programs including account targeting, messaging, competitive positioning, and business value frameworks.
* Measure and optimize program performance based on pipeline generation, opportunity progression, and business impact.


 Enable Sales & Partners
   

  

* Equip Client Executives, Systems Engineers, and partners with the tools and knowledge needed to identify and advance AI opportunities.
* Deliver enablement, account planning support, and strategic guidance to increase AI opportunity creation.
* Support key opportunities through executive engagement, business case development, and competitive strategy.


 Build the AI Ecosystem
   

  

* Develop relationships with hyperscalers, GPU vendors, systems integrators, AI software providers, and cloud partners.
* Drive joint go-to-market initiatives and partner-led pipeline generation.


 Success Measures
   

  

* Generate consistent, high-quality AI pipeline across EMEA/LATAM.
* Increase AI-related bookings and improve conversion rates.
* Grow AI adoption within existing customers and secure new AI-focused accounts.
* Increase partner-sourced opportunities and ecosystem engagement.
* Drive adoption of AI sales plays across the wider Sales and technical organizations.


 Job Requirements:
   

  

**Required**
* 8+ years of experience in Business Development, Strategic Sales, Go-to-Market, AI, Cloud, or Enterprise Technology roles.
* Proven track record of generating pipeline and influencing business growth within emerging or high-growth technology markets.
* Experience creating target account strategies and executing measurable outbound demand-generation programs.
* Working knowledge of AI infrastructure, including GPU environments, model training and inferencing, data pipelines, RAG architectures, vector databases, and AI platforms.
* Ability to translate technical capabilities into business outcomes and executive-level value propositions.
* Strong stakeholder management, collaboration, and influencing skills across matrixed organizations.
* Fluent English and willingness to travel across EMEA/LATAM as required.


**Preferred**
* Experience working with hyperscalers, AI ecosystem partners, systems integrators, or channel-led sales models.
* Understanding of AI regulation, data sovereignty, and compliance considerations across Europe and international markets.
* Experience building new GTM motions, market development programs, and strategic growth initiatives from the ground up.
* Existing relationships within the AI ecosystem, including AI startups, sovereign AI initiatives, cloud providers, GPU vendors, or AI-focused partners.
* Additional European language skills are advantageous.


 Why Join NetApp?
   

  

 This is an opportunity to help shape NetApp's AI growth strategy across EMEA and LATAM. You will work at the intersection of AI, data, cloud, and infrastructure, enabling organizations to accelerate AI adoption while helping build a scalable, repeatable growth engine for one of the industry's most important technology markets.
   

  

 At NetApp, we embrace a hybrid working environment designed to strengthen connection, collaboration, and culture for all employees. This means that most roles will have some level of in-office and/or in-person expectations, which will be shared during the recruitment process.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity Employer:**
 NetApp is firmly committed to Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) and to compliance with all federal, state and local laws that prohibit employment discrimination based on age, race, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, religion, disability or genetic information, pregnancy, protected veteran status, and any other protected classification.
   

  

**Why You'll Thrive at NetApp**
 At NetApp, you won't wait for the perfect moment—you'll make it. The early planning, the extra thought, the bold idea that turns good into great: That's how our people operate and how we continue to push the boundaries of data infrastructure.
   

  

 NetApp is the trusted partner for organizations transforming data into opportunity. As the only enterprise-grade storage service natively embedded in Google Cloud, AWS, and Microsoft Azure, we empower customers to run everything from traditional workloads to enterprise AI with unmatched performance, resilience, and security.
   

  

**Our culture**
 We celebrate mold breakers, bold thinkers, and problem solvers. We reward initiative, impact, and ownership. We provide flexibility so you can balance professional ambition with your personal life. Here, differences are not just welcomed—they drive everything we do.
   

  

 If you're ready to innovate, rise to the challenge, and own every moment - make your next move your best one. Apply now.
   

  

**Submitting an Application**
 To ensure a streamlined and fair hiring process for all candidates, our team only reviews applications submitted through our company website. This practice allows us to track, assess, and respond to applicants efficiently. Emailing our employees, recruiters, or Human Resources personnel directly will not influence your application.
   

  

**AI Disclosure**
 For select roles, some stages of our hiring process may use artificial intelligence tools to help evaluate applications and candidate selection. These tools support—rather than replace—human decision-making.

title: AI-utvecklare med inriktning mot LLM och RAG till Sigma Technology Digital Solutions
description:
Vi söker två AI-utvecklare till ett uppdrag där du bygger ett verktyg som automatiskt föreslår mappningar mellan fritextbegrepp och standardiserade kodverk. Det är ett arbete som idag görs manuellt av specialister, och som med rätt teknik kan bli både snabbare och mer träffsäkert. Du kommer in tidigt, från prototyp till driftsatt tjänst, och är med och sätter både teknik och metodik.
 



  





**Vad du kommer att göra** 




 Du utvecklar en AI-baserad lösning som tar emot begrepp, termer eller lokala koder och föreslår rankade träffar ur ett standardiserat kodverk, tillsammans med en motivering till varför förslaget ser ut som det gör. Användaren granskar, väljer och ger återkoppling när matchningen inte håller. Den återkopplingen är en central del av lösningen, inte en eftertanke.
 



 Rent tekniskt handlar det om en lösning byggd på stora språkmodeller och RAG, med integration mot terminologiserver och externa datakällor. Du bygger API:er och backendkomponenter, arbetar med embeddings, vektordatabaser och semantisk sökning, och ser till att loggning, spårbarhet och kvalitetsuppföljning finns på plats från början. Du är också med och formar gränssnittet där förslagen valideras, tillsammans med de som faktiskt ska använda det.
 



 Du arbetar nära arkitekt, testare, verksamhetsspecialister och kundens AI-team. En stor del av vardagen är dialog: att förstå hur specialisterna resonerar, utvärdera modellens utfall tillsammans med dem och justera. Uppdraget omfattar leverans av en Proof of Concept, en implementerad tjänst, API-gränssnitt, teknisk dokumentation och metodstöd för fortsatt förvaltning. Kunskapsöverföring till kundens egna team ingår i uppdraget.
 



  





  





**Vi söker dig som** 



* har minst 5 års erfarenhet av mjukvaruutveckling, varav minst 3 år med inriktning mot AI och maskininlärning
* har minst 3 års erfarenhet av att bygga sammanhängande AI-lösningar hela vägen från datainhämtning och bearbetning till modellintegration och driftsättning
* har utvecklat och driftsatt lösningar baserade på stora språkmodeller i produktionsmiljö
* har arbetat med RAG samt integration av verktyg och datakällor via MCP
* har erfarenhet av vektordatabaser och semantisk sökning, inklusive embeddings och likhetsbaserad matchning
* har minst 2 års erfarenhet av molnmiljöer och containerteknik som Docker och Kubernetes
* har integrerat AI-lösningar mot API:er, backendsystem och externa tjänster
* bygger lösningar som är skalbara, säkra och går att förvalta över tid
* är stark i Python och relevanta AI- och ML-ramverk
* har god förståelse för NLP, inklusive lexikal, semantisk och kontextuell analys, gärna i domänspecifika sammanhang



  





**Rekryteringsprocessen** 




 Vi tror på en tydlig och respektfull process. Här är vad du kan förvänta dig:
 


1. Introduktionssamtal (20–30 minuter) där vi lär känna varandra och du får svar på dina första frågor.
2. Teknisk intervju där vi går igenom erfarenheter och resonerar kring konkreta problem tillsammans.
3. Fördjupat intervjusamtal (60 minuter). Vi går på djupet kring roll, förväntningar och vad vi kan erbjuda varandra.



  





**Om oss** 




 Sigma Technology Digital Solutions är ett konsultbolag med 60+ experter i Göteborg, Stockholm och Örebro. Vi är en del av Sigma Technology Group, ett av Sveriges mest erfarna teknikföretag med verksamhet i ett tiotal länder.
 



 Vi tror på att skapa möjligheter som inte bara främjar karriärer utan också bidrar till en bättre morgondag. Hos oss får du tryggheten i en stabil arbetsgivare och friheten att påverka din egen resa. Du blir en del av ett engagerat team där vi delar kunskap och idéer, satsar på teknikförnyelse och ser gärna att du är med och driver det framåt.
 



 Vi jobbar med kunder inom flera branscher, från industri och fintech till offentlig sektor. Det innebär bredd i dina uppdrag och möjligheten att välja en riktning som passar dig, tekniskt, kommersiellt och geografiskt.
 



 Vad blir din nästa utmaning?
 



  





**Det vi erbjuder** 




 Kollektivavtal, friskvårdsbidrag på 4 950 kr per år, extra flexpension och trygga villkor med kompletterande föräldralön.
 



 Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning hos Sigma Technology Digital Solutions med placering i kunduppdrag.

title: Software Engineer - Data, Lakehouse and AI Data Platform Engineer - Vice President
description:
**Job Description**
**The Opportunity**
 Join a team building the data foundations that support the firm’s AI and analytics capabilities. This role sits within the engineering effort to develop a modern Lakehouse and AI data platform that enables reliable, well-governed and high-performing data use across the firm.
   

  

 At Goldman Sachs, engineering teams are positioned at the centre of the business, building scalable systems, solving complex technical problems and turning data into action. In data engineering roles, the emphasis is on designing, building and maintaining large-scale data platforms, delivering production pipelines, improving reliability and quality, and partnering closely with users of the platform.
   

  

 This is a delivery-focused role for engineers who want to build robust data assets in production, work with modern data technologies, and grow over time within the firm. You will contribute to the data models, pipelines and platform capabilities that underpin analytics, operational decision-making and emerging AI use cases.
   

  

**Role Summary**
 As a
 **Data Engineer, Lakehouse and AI Data Platform** 
 , you will design, build, test and support data pipelines and curated datasets on the firm’s modern data platform. You will work across ingestion, transformation, modelling, optimisation and data quality, helping to deliver data products that are reliable, scalable and fit for purpose.
   

  

 The role is suited to engineers who are comfortable writing code, working with SQL and distributed data processing, and solving practical delivery problems in a team environment. More experienced candidates may also contribute to technical design, platform standards and the shaping of delivery approaches across a wider set of use cases.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Pipeline Engineering**
* Build, enhance and support batch and streaming data pipelines on the Lakehouse and AI data platform.
* Refactor or modernise existing data flows where needed to improve reliability, performance and maintainability.
* Ensure data pipelines are production-ready, well tested and operationally supportable.


**Data Modelling and Curation**
* Develop raw, refined and curated datasets that support analytics, reporting and AI use cases.
* Apply sound data modelling principles to represent business entities, relationships and historical change accurately.
* Work with consumers to shape data products that are usable, well documented and aligned to business needs.


**Data Quality and Reconciliation**
* Implement controls to validate completeness, accuracy and consistency of data across pipelines and datasets.
* Use reconciliation approaches to build confidence in production outputs and investigate breaks where they arise.
* Contribute to clear standards for testing, monitoring and issue resolution.


**Delivery and Partnership**
* Work closely with engineers, platform teams and data consumers to deliver agreed outcomes to time and quality expectations.
* Communicate clearly on progress, risks, dependencies and design choices.
* Take a broader role in technical leadership, task breakdown and support for junior engineers.


**Required**
**Skills and Experience**
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in a relevant discipline, or equivalent practical experience, with evidence of strong quantitative skills or data engineering expertise.
* Strong hands-on programming experience in Python or Java.
* Good working knowledge of SQL, including troubleshooting, optimisation and data analysis.
* Ability to learn new tools, internal platforms and delivery workflows quickly.
* Familiarity with software engineering fundamentals, including version control, testing, release discipline and CI/CD practices.


**Data Engineering Capability**
* Stronger ownership of technical design across multiple datasets or pipeline domains.
* Experience guiding implementation standards, code quality and engineering practices within a team.
* Ability to lead delivery for a workstream, manage dependencies and support less experienced engineers.
* Understanding of temporal data modelling, including the handling of historical state and change over time.
* Knowledge of schema design, schema evolution and data compatibility considerations.
* Understanding of partitioning, clustering and other techniques used to improve data performance at scale.
* Ability to make sensible design choices across normalised and denormalised models, and between natural and surrogate keys.
* Practical approach to data quality, reconciliation and root-cause analysis.
* Experience building or supporting production data pipelines in a collaborative engineering environment.
* Experience working with distributed data processing frameworks such as Apache Spark.
* Working knowledge of common data formats such as JSON, Avro and Parquet.


**Technology Environment**
 The role will involve working with a modern and evolving data stack. Candidates are not expected to have deep expertise in every tool from day one but should bring relevant experience and the ability to work across comparable technologies.
   

  

**Examples Of Technologies In Scope Include**
* Data processing and logic: ANSI SQL, Apache Spark, Kafka
* Data formats: JSON, Avro, Parquet
* Platforms and storage: Snowflake, Apache Iceberg, Databricks, Hadoop ecosystem technologies, Sybase IQ
* Engineering and deployment: CI/CD tooling, containerised or Kubernetes-based deployment approaches where relevant


 You will also work with internal data management and platform tooling, so a practical and adaptable engineering mindset is important.
   

  

**What We Are Looking For**
 We are looking for engineers who can deliver well-structured, reliable solutions in production and who take ownership of the quality of what they build. The role suits candidates who are technically strong, pragmatic and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where data platforms support important business outcomes.
   

  

**Stronger Candidates Will Typically Demonstrate**
* sound judgement in technical trade-offs
* attention to detail in data correctness and testing
* a clear and structured approach to problem solving
* willingness to work closely with stakeholders and partner teams
* an interest in developing long-term expertise within the firm


**About Goldman Sachs**
 At Goldman Sachs, we commit our people, capital and ideas to help our clients, shareholders and the communities we serve to grow. Founded in 1869, we are a leading global investment banking, securities and investment management firm. Headquartered in New York, we maintain offices around the world.
   

  

 We believe who you are makes you better at what you do. We're committed to fostering and advancing diversity and inclusion in our own workplace and beyond by ensuring every individual within our firm has a number of opportunities to grow professionally and personally, from our training and development opportunities and firmwide networks to benefits, wellness and personal finance offerings and mindfulness programs. Learn more about our culture, benefits, and people at GS.com/careers.
   

  

 We’re committed to finding reasonable accommodations for candidates with special needs or disabilities during our recruiting process. Learn more: https://www.goldmansachs.com/careers/footer/disability-statement.html
   

  

 © The Goldman Sachs Group, Inc., 2023. All rights reserved.
   

  

 Goldman Sachs is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, veterans status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

title: Sales Specialist
description:
**Introduction to Eficode**
 We’re building the future of software development - driving innovation across Cloud, DevOps, Agile, Service Management, and AI-powered transformation. Our mission is to help organizations evolve into truly software-driven enterprises, empowering them to deliver faster, smarter, and more sustainably through modern technology and intelligent automation.
   

  

 At Eficode, we help some of the world’s leading organisations modernise the way they build software by combining DevOps culture, platform engineering, AI-assisted software development, and cloud-native tooling. From intelligent automation to agentic workflows and AI-enhanced SDLC (Software Development Life Cycle) practices, we are at the forefront of helping teams transform how software is delivered.
   

  

 As an Atlassian Platinum Solution Partner, we have been recognised multiple times as Atlassian Partner of the Year, most recently for Software Solutions, 2026. We are also proud to be a two-time GitHub Partner of the Year in EMEA, a GitLab Select Partner, and an Azure Managed Service Provider.
   

  

 With over 600 experts across 10 countries, we bring together leading talent from the Nordics, continental Europe, the UK, and the Americas.
   

  

**Role purpose**
 As a Sales Specialist at Eficode, you will play a key role in driving growth across our strategic solution areas by combining strong commercial acumen with a solid understanding of modern technology ecosystems.
   

  

 You’ll work closely with regional sales teams, solution consultants, marketing, and delivery teams to identify and close new business opportunities, helping customers understand how Eficode’s services and solutions can support their transformation journeys.
   

  

 This role is ideal for someone who thrives in fast-paced sales environments, enjoys building relationships and creating opportunities, and is excited by the evolving world of Cloud, DevOps, AI-powered software development, and modern enterprise tooling.
   

  

**Role Responsibilities**
 Your main responsibilities as our Sales Specialist will include (but won’t be limited to):
   

  

* Owning and achieving individual sales quotas across designated solution areas, including both shadow quotas and full quotas for new business opportunities
* Working closely with regional account managers and marketing teams to identify, qualify, and close strategic opportunities
* Developing and maintaining strong relationships with strategic technology partners and vendors, identifying joint go-to-market opportunities and leveraging partner ecosystems to drive pipeline growth
* Building tailored customer proposals, presentations, and solution positioning aligned to customer needs and business goals
* Acting as a trusted advisor and subject matter expert across assigned solution areas
* Collaborating with pre-sales and delivery teams to scope, position, and package offerings that balance customer value with commercial success
* Maintaining accurate pipeline management and forecasting within CRM systems
* Driving pipeline growth and supporting cross-sell and upsell opportunities across the Eficode portfolio
* Representing Eficode at customer meetings, events, webinars, and industry engagements as a solution evangelist
* Building and maintaining strong relationships across customer and partner networks


**Role Requirements**
 You will make a great match for this role if you have:
   

  

* Previous experience working within B2B SaaS sales, IT consulting sales, or enterprise software licensing environments
* Experience selling cloud, SaaS, or consumption-based licensing solutions
* A strong hunter mentality, with experience generating and closing new business opportunities
* Experience working with enterprise customers and navigating complex sales cycles
* A solid understanding of modern software development ecosystems, cloud platforms, or DevOps-related technologies
* Excellent communication and relationship-building skills in English
* A proactive, commercially driven, and collaborative mindset
* The ability to work cross-functionally with sales, technical, marketing, and delivery teams
* An established professional network within relevant markets or industries


**Nice To Have’s**
 It would be an added bonus if you have:
   

  

* Experience working with Atlassian, GitHub, GitLab, AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, or DevOps toolchains
* Experience selling or working with large enterprise platforms such as ServiceNow, Salesforce, or Workday
* Previous experience working in consultancy or partner-led sales environments
* Knowledge of AI-powered software development, cloud transformation, or platform engineering concepts
* Swedish or Danish language skills for customer-facing work would be beneficial


**Location & Setup**

* This is a full-time position with typical office hours and flexibility where needed
* The role reports to the Head of Account Management Scandinavia
* Possible locations: Stockholm,, Malmö, or Copenhagen
* Compensation includes a market-based salary with a commission plan (OTE model)


**How To Apply**
 If this sounds like the right opportunity for you, we’d love to hear from you - apply today!
   

  

 A member of our Talent Acquisition team will review your application and, if your profile is a match, will be in contact to organise an initial screening call. If you are not selected to move forward in the process, we will also make sure to keep you informed.
   

  

**What’s in it for you?**
 Eficode offer a range of perks and benefits for employees, including:
   

  

* Generous paid holiday
* Health insurance & pension scheme
* Learning & development - We have knowledge sharing sessions, team activities, technical and soft skills trainings to all Eficodeans in our Academy.
* Regular social events, lunches and code camps
* A work laptop, phone and necessary work equipment


 To find out more about life at Eficode, and hear what our people think about us, click here.
   

  

**Application process**
 If this role sounds like a good fit, we encourage you to apply today. Selected candidates will be invited to an initial screening call with our Talent Acquisition team. The process then includes two interviews, followed by a final informal team coffee - giving you the chance to get to know your future colleagues and experience the team culture firsthand.
   

  

**DEI Statement**
 At Eficode we are committed to offering an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunities for all applicants. We are dedicated to creating a work environment that embraces diversity, inclusion, and respect for all employees. We believe that our differences make us better. We recognise that by having diverse perspectives, skills, ages, genders, backgrounds, and cultures, we will better drive our customers forward and innovate in our field.
   

  

 To ensure a fair recruitment process, please refrain from sharing unnecessary personal information or an image of yourself in your job application.
   

  

**Salary Development**
 At Eficode, we believe your compensation should reflect the impact you make and how you grow along the way. Your salary develops through regular check-ins with your team lead, where we look at things like your skills, experience, client work, feedback, and overall contribution — both to your projects and to our culture.  Find out more about our benefits [here].

 Eficode never asks for payment, bank details, or sensitive personal information during the recruitment process. We only communicate through official Eficode email accounts and approved recruitment platforms. If you receive an unsolicited message, job offer, or request for personal or financial information claiming to be from Eficode, it may be fraudulent.

title: Senior Presales Engineer - Server & Storage
description:

 , you'll be the trusted technical advisor for both our sales teams and Dell partners.
   

  

 Working at the intersection of technology and business, you'll help partners design the right Dell infrastructure solutions, support them throughout the sales process, and strengthen their technical capabilities through enablement and training.

 Sales Support & Technical Advisory

title: IT Infrastructure Specialist - Nordea Life & Pension
description:
**Job ID: 3887**
 Are you passionate about technology and IT Operations? We are looking for an IT Infrastructure Specialist to manage both operational and strategic work to support and develop our IT environment.
   

  

 At Nordea, we know our customers’ needs are changing – and we’re deeply committed to meeting them with the financial solutions of tomorrow. We’re creating an agile environment where we’re harnessing the power of technology – one where you can make an impact. So bring your skills, ideas and unique background. With us, you’ll find plenty of opportunities to grow and make your mark on something bigger.
   

  

**About This Opportunity**
 Welcome to the NLPSE IT Operations Team. We are looking for an IT Infrastructure Specialist to manage both operational and strategic work to support and develop our IT environment. As IT Infrastructure Specialist, you’ll play a valuable role in handle simple to complex incoming cases that require investigative work. This is an opportunity for you to join Nordea Life & Pensions Sweden own IT department. We are responsible for, and work as a natural partner with, all IT-related areas within the subsidiary and the business processes. You will join NLP SE where we are responsible for Nordea Life & Pension IT Operations from a company perspective and are attached to Nordea Central IT. Understanding of Lumera, our core Life & Pension administration platform, will be a significant asset in supporting and developing our services.
   

  

**What you’ll be doing:**
* Work hands-on with the operation, maintenance, and enhancement of the Lumera platform, supporting Life & Pension business processes.
* Support Nordea Life & Pensions IT platform (Windows Servers, SQL Databases, Java and windows application)
* Troubleshooting IT-related issues
* IT-related support for our business applications
* On-going operation, support and troubleshooting
* SQL Database troubleshooting from an Lumera application perspective.


 The role is based in Stockholm. Welcome to a team in a dynamic environment along with ten other colleagues (two on application support, seven on IT operations support and a team manager). Together we are responsible for Nordea Life & Pension IT Operations from a company perspective and are attached to Nordea Central IT.
   

  

 In the role as IT Operation Specialist you will participate in the scheduled on-call support.
   

  

**Who You Are**
 Collaboration. Ownership. Passion. Courage. These are the values that guide us in being at our best – and that we imagine you share with us. We are looking for a pro-active, energetic and result driven individual to take this role to the next level!
   

  

 You have a high focus on quality in both execution and delivery. You are good at planning and prioritizing your work in a structured way. You are driven by delivering first class service and always to do the utmost to resolve the user's case at any given time.
   

  

**To succeed in this role, we believe that you:**
* Good knowledge of operations and support and have a genuine interest in new technology.
* Windows server
* Fluency in written and spoken Swedish and English.
* Experience in Installation & Configuration and monitoring
* Great knowledge in general of IPC process (Incident, problem and change with Helix tool or likewise)
* Lumera application and database knowledge.


**It is an advantage if you have experience in several of the following areas:**
* Lumera knowledge from an Operational perspective.
* Insurance knowledge and how Lumera application works.
* Knowledge of Lumera and Life & Pension processes.
* Tomcat , Wildfly or other application servers
* Databases, like Microsoft SQL
* AppDynamics, Splunk
* SQL


**What We Offer**
**People** 
 are driven by many different factors. For some, it’s to take their career to the next level. For others, it’s to break new ground within their area of expertise – in other words, with us, you will always move forward.
   

  

**A culture** 
 that fosters performance and growth in one of the largest Nordic banks, offering various opportunities to evolve, develop and learn from brilliant colleagues with diverse backgrounds in a vibrant working environment.
   

  

**Hybrid working model –** 
 we believe in the value of bringing people together and at the same time we embrace the freedom of flexibility.
   

  

**Diversity and inclusion** 
 are a natural part of our daily work. We know that an inclusive workplace is a sustainable one. We genuinely believe that our diverse backgrounds, experiences, characteristics and traits make us stronger together. Every day we strive to find new ways to improve diversity and inclusion within our community e.g. we have signed the European Diversity Charters in the countries where we operate to show our commitment and engage with others to continue learning and improving.
   

  

 If this sounds like you, get in touch!
   

  

**Next steps**
 Submit your application no later than 31/08/2026. For more information, you’re welcome to contact Head of IT Operations, Daniel Constantinescu at daniel.constantinescu @nordea.se.
   

  

 For union information, please contact Finansförbundet at finansforbundet@nordea.se or SACO at SacoNordea@nordea.com.

description:

Rededge specialiserar sig på affärssystem och levererar expertkompetens inom Oracle NetSuite och Oracle ERP Cloud. * Meriterande med erfarenhet av ERP-system, främst Oracle Netsuite, Oracle ERP Cloud, Microsoft, SAP och Infor
* Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift



  





 För att trivas i rollen är det viktigt att du har en hög motivation och ett starkt driv. Du är en “doer” som gillar att ta ansvar och har förmågan att få saker att hända – oavsett om det handlar om att driva projekt framåt eller hitta lösningar på komplexa problem. Du är flexibel och har lätt för att anpassa dig till nya utmaningar och olika kundbehov.
 



  





 Som person är du kommunikativ, både muntligt och skriftligt, och har lätt för att bygga goda relationer med både kunder och kollegor. Din nyfikenhet och vilja att lära dig mer om affärssystem och dess processer är avgörande för att utvecklas i rollen och bli en framtida expert inom området. Vi söker någon som tar initiativ, trivs i en dynamisk miljö och har en positiv inställning som smittar av sig på kunder och medarbetare.

title: Cyber Defence Expert - Incident Management & Response
description:
**Job Description**
**Solve complex problems. Decode the future.**
 At Electrolux Group, as a leading global appliance company, we strive every day to shape living for the better for our consumers, our people and our planet. We share ideas and collaborate so that together, we can develop solutions that deliver enjoyable and sustainable living.
   

  

 Come join us as you are. We believe diverse perspectives make us stronger and more innovative. In our global community of people from 100+ countries, we listen to each other, actively contribute, and grow together.
   

  

 Join us in our exciting quest to build the future home.
   

  

**All about the role:**
 We are looking for a highly experienced Cyber Defense Expert to act as a Incident Management and Response subject matter expert while leading the operational maturity and effectiveness of the Security Operations Center. The role is accountable for driving strong incident lifecycle management, from detection, triage, escalation and containment through eradication, recovery, executive communication and lessons learned.
   

  

 You will play a central role in protecting the organization by leading cyber incident response, strengthening SOC effectiveness and improving operational resilience across a global environment. This is an opportunity to make a direct impact on how cyber threats are detected, managed, contained and learned from, while helping mature people, processes and technologies that underpin modern cyber defense.
   

  

**What you'll do:**
**Incident Management & Response Leadership**
* Lead end-to-end cyber incident response activities across detection, triage, analysis, containment, eradication, recovery and closure.
* Act as incident commander or senior response lead for high-severity cyber incidents, ensuring clear ownership, decision-making, escalation and communication.
* Design, maintain and continuously improve incident response frameworks, playbooks, severity models, escalation paths and operating procedures.
* Coordinate technical investigations across SOC, infrastructure, cloud, endpoint, identity, network, application and third-party teams.
* Drive post-incident reviews, root cause analysis, corrective actions and measurable improvements to reduce recurrence and improve response effectiveness.


**SOC Leadership & Operational Excellence**
* Lead and mature SOC operations, including alert triage quality, investigation standards, escalation discipline, response workflows and service performance.
* Define and track SOC metrics, SLAs, KPIs and executive reporting related to detection, response, backlog, false positives, incident trends and operational effectiveness.
* Provide operational governance for managed SOC providers, ensuring clear accountability, quality assurance, continuous improvement and alignment with cyber defence objectives.
* Improve detection-to-response processes by strengthening SIEM, SOAR, EDR, NDR, XDR, identity and cloud security workflows.
* Support analyst enablement through guidance, process clarity, knowledge sharing, playbook adoption and lessons learned from real incidents.


**Detection Engineering & Automation**
* Own and mature detection engineering capabilities across SIEM, SOAR, EDR, NDR, XDR, identity, cloud, SaaS and other critical security telemetry sources.
* Translate threat intelligence, incident lessons learned, threat hunting outcomes and MITRE ATT&CK techniques into actionable detection use cases and response logic.
* Lead the detection lifecycle, including use case design, prioritization, validation, tuning, false-positive reduction, coverage assessment and retirement of ineffective detections.
* Drive SOC automation through SOAR playbooks, automated enrichment, triage support, case management workflows, containment actions and repeatable response processes.
* Identify telemetry and logging gaps, prioritize onboarding of critical data sources and improve visibility across enterprise, cloud and identity environments.
* Partner with SOC analysts, incident responders, threat hunters, platform owners and managed service providers to continuously improve detection coverage, response speed and operational efficiency.


**Crisis Readiness, Communication & Stakeholder Coordination**
* Lead cyber crisis coordination during major incidents, ensuring timely updates, clear business impact assessment and effective engagement with senior stakeholders.
* Prepare and deliver incident briefings, executive summaries, situation reports and post-incident reports for technical and non-technical audiences.
* Partner with legal, privacy, communications, risk, compliance and business continuity teams when incidents require broader enterprise coordination.
* Plan and support cyber incident exercises, tabletop simulations and readiness assessments to validate response capabilities and decision-making.
* Ensure incident response activities are aligned with internal governance, regulatory expectations and established security policies.


**Qualifications** 
**:**
* Minimum 8 years of experience in security operations, cyber defence, incident response or related cybersecurity roles.
* Strong hands-on experience leading or coordinating high-severity cyber incidents in complex enterprise environments.
* Deep understanding of SOC operations, alert triage, escalation management, incident handling, threat detection and response workflows.
* Experience with SIEM, SOAR, EDR, NDR, XDR, identity security, cloud security monitoring and managed security service providers.
* Strong understanding of incident response frameworks and methodologies such as NIST, ISO 27035, SANS/PICERL and MITRE ATT&CK.
* Ability to communicate clearly during incidents, including concise executive updates, technical coordination and post-incident reporting.
* Proven ability to drive continuous improvement across people, process, tooling, governance and operational performance.
* Relevant bachelor’s or master’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* Relevant certifications are considered an advantage, such as CISSP, GCIH, GCIA, GCFA, GSEC, OSCP, CEH, Microsoft Security certifications or cloud security certifications.


**Where you'll be:**
 This is a position based at our Global Headquarters in Stockholm (Sweden).
   

  

 We are proud of our culture of inclusivity and diversity. At our Global Headquarters we have 60+ nationalities working together for our common goals. You will be part of this dynamic international team where English is the natural language.
   

  

 We work in a hybrid set up that gives everyone up to 20% flexibiltiy to work remotely, while boosting creatvity and collaboration through regular office presence.
   

  

**Our recruitment process may include interviews, assessments, and reference checks. As part of our recruitment process, a background check may be conducted on the final candidate(s). Any checks will be carried out in accordance with applicable laws and with the candidate's knowledge and consent.**
 We look forward to receiving your application!
   

  

 As part of Electrolux, we will continuously invest in you and your development. There are no barriers to where your career could take you.

 Be great fun to work with.

Millions of customers - including the fastest-growing startups, largest enterprises, and leading government agencies - are using AWS to lower costs, become more agile, and innovate faster.

title: Principal GenAI GTM Specialist, WWSO
description:
**Description**
 Are you a customer-obsessed builder with a passion for helping enterprises unlock transformative value from Generative AI? Do you combine deep technical proficiency in GenAI — foundation models, Amazon Bedrock, agentic architectures — with the business acumen to land AI transformation programmes tied to real customer outcomes? Do you thrive at the intersection of technology strategy and commercial execution? Join the EMEA Go-to-Market Specialist Team to lead the GenAI transformation agenda across one of AWS's highest-growth and most strategic domains.
   

  

 The Worldwide Specialist Organization (WWSO) is part of AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS). We work backwards from our customers' most complex and business-critical problems to build and execute go-to-market plans that turn AWS ideas into multi-billion-dollar businesses. WWSO teams include business development, specialist solutions architecture, and go-to-market.
   

  

 This is a Principal-level GenAI GTM Specialist role responsible for driving enterprise Generative AI adoption across EMEA. Rather than owning a single service, you will own the cross-cutting GenAI transformation narrative — spanning Amazon Bedrock, agentic architectures, foundation model strategy, and emerging GenAI capabilities — and translate it into use-case-led motions that land measurable business outcomes in customers.
   

  

 What We're Looking For
   

  

* Deep technical proficiency in Generative AI: foundation models, agentic patterns, and the Amazon Bedrock ecosystem.
* Demonstrated ability to land AI/ML transformation programmes in enterprise customers translating technology capability into business outcomes by use case.
* A blend of technical depth and commercial savvy equally comfortable whiteboarding a Think Big architecture and presenting an AI strategy to a C-suite.
* Experience building and executing GTM strategies at scale in a fast-moving technology domain.


 Track record of operating as a thought leader and trusted advisor to senior customer stakeholders.
   

  

* Ability to thrive in a high-ambiguity, high-velocity environment and shape direction without waiting for permission
* Data-driven approach to prioritization using pipeline data, propensity signals, and market intelligence to focus effort where it matters most
* Experience in enterprise technology sales, solutions architecture, or technical business development with a focus on AI/ML or cloud platforms
* Strong written and verbal communication able to author SLT-level narratives, field-facing plays, and customer-facing positioning with equal fluency


 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Own the EMEA GenAI GTM strategy end-to-end driving enterprise adoption of Amazon Bedrock and complementary GenAI services through use case led motion, define the narrative, identify high-impact use-case patterns.
* Land AI transformation in enterprises: develop and execute account-level GenAI strategies for priority industries, mapping business priorities to GenAI use cases, building transformation roadmaps, and guiding customers from proof-of-concept to production at scale.
* Operate at the CxO/VP and practitioner level: engage senior business leaders on AI strategy and value realisation while simultaneously working with developers, ML engineers, and architects on technical solution design and adoption patterns.
* Build and execute scaled GTM programmes : design motions including customer roundtables, GenAI workload assessments, use-case workshops, developer engagement, and regional campaigns that create demand and accelerate adoption.
* Thought Leadership : Create packaged deliverables (propensity models, use-case frameworks) and drive enablement that raises the bar across the EMEA field.
* Be the voice of EMEA customers to Product: synthesise regional customer requirements, competitive signals, and adoption blockers into actionable feedback that shapes Amazon Bedrock and GenAI service roadmaps.
* Influence Marketing: co-develop thought leadership, digital campaigns, and customer success stories that position AWS as the platform of choice for enterprise GenAI transformation.
* Drive cross-functional alignment across Specialist, Field, Partner, and Marketing teams to ensure consistent messaging and coordinated execution


 A day in the life
   

  

 You will lead the go-to-market strategy for one of the most exciting and high-growth domains in cloud. No two days are the same. You might start your morning on a deep-dive with a Fortune 500 financial services CTO mapping their enterprise-wide GenAI transformation roadmap — identifying the highest-value use cases, from intelligent document processing to autonomous customer service agents. After lunch, you're running a use-case workshop with a major retailer's engineering team, helping them see how Amazon Bedrock can power their next-generation product discovery experience and building the business case to take to their board. Later, you're jumping into a pipeline review with an Area AI/ML sales leader to pressure-test which opportunities are ready to move from pilot to production, before briefing a product team on what EMEA customers need next from Bedrock based on patterns you're seeing across dozens of enterprise engagements.
   

  

 You'll collaborate daily with account teams, solution architects, partner managers, and AWS service teams — connecting the dots between customer business priorities, GenAI technical capabilities, and market opportunity. Your job is to make the complex simple: translating the art of the possible in Generative AI into concrete, use-case-led transformation programmes that customers can execute and measure. You operate as the connective tissue between what AWS builds and how enterprises adopt it at scale.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The EMEA WWSO AI/ML Geo Specialist team within AWS's Worldwide Specialist Organization owns and executes go-to-market strategy for the full portfolio of AWS AI/ML services. We serve customers across the complete AI lifecycle while also leading the way to drive net new innovative use cases in this domain. Our customers include some of the most technically sophisticated organizations in the world, and our work directly impacts how AI is built and deployed across EMEA.
   

  

 You will join a team of passionate builders who combine deep technical curiosity with commercial acumen. We operate with a startup mentality inside one of the world's largest technology companies—moving fast, experimenting boldly, and holding ourselves to the highest standards.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Experience in Go-To-Market, Business Development, Sales, or Consulting
* Experience developing strategies that influence leadership decisions at the organizational level
* Demonstrated technical proficiency in Generative AI concepts with the ability to credibly engage technical and business audiences.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience selling to Fortune 1000 or Global 2000 organizations
* Background that blends technical depth with commercial ownership (pipeline, revenue, GTM planning).

title: Senior SAP-Consultant
description:
Implema växer och vi söker seniora SAP-konsulter som vill kombinera specialistkompetens med verkligt inflytande.
   

  

 Hos oss blir du inte bara en konsult bland många. Du får möjlighet att påverka kunders utveckling, bidra till vår affär och vara en aktiv del av Implemas fortsatta tillväxt. Vi söker dig som vill ta ansvar, bygga långsiktiga relationer och dela med dig av din erfarenhet till både kunder och kollegor.
   

  

 Här värdesätts initiativkraft, engagemang och viljan att göra skillnad tillsammans.
   

  

**Är du vår nya kollega?**
 Vi söker erfarna SAP-konsulter inom logistik, produktion, inköp eller ekonomi som vill vara med och utveckla både kunder och Implema.
   

  

**Som SAP-konsult hos oss**
* Arbetar du nära kunder inom olika branscher för att förstå verksamhetens behov och skapa affärsvärde genom SAP-lösningar.
* Tar du en nyckelroll i implementations- och transformationsprojekt samt fungerar som en strategisk rådgivare till kunden.
* Bidrar du med specialistkompetens inom ditt område och har möjlighet att utvecklas tekniskt, strategiskt och/eller som ledare.
* Arbetar du tillsammans med erfarna kollegor i en kultur som präglas av kompetens, samarbete och kunskapsdelning.
* Bidrar du till utvecklingen av vårt erbjudande, våra affärer och nästa generation konsulter.


**Välj det arbetssätt som passar dig**
 Hos oss kan du arbeta på olika sätt beroende på vad som motiverar dig.
   

  

*Expert Consulting*
 Långsiktiga uppdrag där du arbetar nära kundens verksamhet, bygger relationer och blir en viktig del av deras team.
   

  

*Teamleverans*
 Projekt tillsammans med Implemas specialister där du får variation, samarbete och möjlighet att bidra i flera olika verksamheter och branscher.
   

  

 Många av våra konsulter väljer att kombinera dessa arbetssätt över tid.
   

  

**Vi söker dig som har**
* Minst fem års erfarenhet som SAP-konsult eller från en verksamhetsnära roll inom SAP.
* Erfarenhet inom ett eller flera områden såsom EWM, PP, MM, SD, FI/CO, QM eller PS.
* Erfarenhet av konfiguration i SAP S/4HANA.
* Ett intresse för kunskapsdelning och att utveckla både människor och verksamheter.
* Flytande svenska och engelska i tal och skrift.


 Erfarenhet av SAP Cloud ERP är meriterande.
   

  

**Vem är du?**
 För att trivas hos oss är du en självgående och affärsorienterad person som trivs i samarbete med andra. Du bygger förtroende, skapar värde för kunder och delar gärna med dig av din kunskap.
   

  

**Därför Väljer Seniora Konsulter Implema**
* Möjlighet att påverka och ta ansvar.
* Nära samarbete med kunder och beslutsfattare
* Kompetenta kollegor med djup SAP- och verksamhetsexpertis.
* Frihet att forma din egen utveckling och karriär samt hög grad av flexibilitet gällande att planera din arbetsvardag, med möjlighet att kombinera arbete på kontor, hos kund och på distans.
* Konkurrenskraftiga villkor. Vi erbjuder marknadsmässig lön, pensions- och försäkringslösningar, friskvårdsbidrag samt sociala aktiviteter, kickoffer och konferenser.


**Intresserad?**
 När du ansöker tar vi en dialog för att lära känna dig, din erfarenhet och dina ambitioner. Vi vill förstå vad som motiverar dig och se hur det matchar våra kunder, projekt och framtida möjligheter.
   

  

*Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig.*
***Implema***
*är en av Sveriges ledande specialister på SAP och Microsoft Dynamics. Med över 20 års erfarenhet och 300 medarbetare på 10 orter runtom i Sverige hjälper vi företag att digitalisera och optimera sina affärsprocesser.*

title: Postdoktor inom Utveckla AL/ML för kvantitativ analys av LNPs
description:
**Arbetsuppgifter**




 Kvantitativ analys av lipidnanopartiklar (LNP) med hjälp av Cryo EM är utmanande på grund av heterogena prover, brist på träningsdata och provvariabilitet. I detta projekt strävar vi efter att utveckla AI/ML-arbetsflöden för förbättrad kvantitativ analys av LNP. Dina ansvarsområden kommer att inkludera optimering av datainsamlingsparametrar för automatiserade analyspipelines; utveckling, optimering och implementering av AI/ML-arbetsflöden och validering av analyser med hjälp av fysikalisk-kemiska metoder. Forskningen kommer att ske i nära samarbete med experimentella LNP-doktorand-/postdoktorsprojekt i Barriga Lab och med M. Carroni vid Cryo EM-anläggningen SciLifeLab. Andra ansvarsområden kan inkludera undervisning, handledning och bidrag till samarbetsprojekt/ansökningar.
   

  





 Barriga Lab är en tvärvetenskaplig grupp som kombinerar biologi, fysik och kemi för att öka vår förståelse av biologiska processer med ett specifikt fokus på struktur-funktionsförhållanden i lipidsystem för läkemedelsleverans (främst lipidnanopartiklar). Gruppen har omfattande expertis inom storskalig forskningsinfrastruktur för att studera lipidsystem och koppla dessa till biologiska analyser.
   

  





 https://barrigalab.com/
   

  





 Gruppen är en del av avdelningen för nanobioteknik inom institutionen för proteinvetenskap och vi finns på SciLifeLab i Solna.
   

  





**Kvalifikationer**




**Krav** 



* Avlagd doktorsexamen eller utländsk examen som bedöms motsvara en doktorsexamen. Detta behörighetskrav ska vara uppfyllt senast vid tidpunkten då anställningsbeslutet fattas.
* Expertis inom storskalig dataanalys
* Erfarenhet av arbete med Cryo EM
* Erfarenhet av att handleda/bihandleda master/ doktorandstudenter
* Erfarenhet av tvärvetenskapligt samarbete och teamwork
* Bevis på förmåga att arbeta självständigt



**Meriterande** 



* Vid sista ansökningsdag högst tre år sedan doktorsexamen eller en utländsk examen som bedöms motsvara doktorsexamen avlades.
* Erfarenhet av arbete med lipidnanopartiklar
* Erfarenhet av arbete med spridning (liten vinkel)
* Förmåga att kommunicera (skriftligt, muntligt) på engelska, då det krävs i det dagliga arbetet
* Medvetenhet om mångfald och likabehandlingsfrågor (särskilt fokus på jämställdhet).



 Vi kommer att lägga stor vikt vid personliga egenskaper.
   

  





**Bli en del av KTH**




 KTH formar framtiden genom utbildning, forskning och innovation. Som ett ledande internationellt tekniskt universitet spelar vi en aktiv roll i att driva och medverka i omställningen till ett hållbart samhälle. Här erbjuds du möjligheten att växa och utvecklas på en kreativ och dynamisk arbetsplats med goda arbetsvillkor och förmåner. Jämställdhet, mångfald och lika villkor är en kvalitetsfråga och en självklar del av KTH:s värdegrund som universitet och statlig myndighet.
   

  





 Läs mer om våra förmåner och hur det är att arbeta och utvecklas på KTH.
   

  





**Fackliga representanter**




 Kontaktuppgifter till
 
 fackliga representanter.
   

  





**Ansökan**




 Du ansöker via KTH:s rekryteringssystem. Du som sökande har huvudansvaret för att din ansökan är komplett när den skickas in.
   

  





 Ansökan ska innehålla: 
 


* CV inklusive relevant yrkeserfarenhet och kunskap.
* Kopia av examensbevis och betyg från dina tidigare universitetsstudier. Översättningar till engelska eller svenska om de ursprungliga dokumenten inte utfärdas på något av dessa språk.
* Personligt brev som beskriver motivationen för forskningen, dina akademiska intressen och hur de relaterar till dina tidigare studier och framtida mål, samt nyckelkompetenser relaterade till tjänsten. Max 2 sidor lång



 Ansökan ska vara KTH tillhanda senast sista ansökningsdagen vid midnatt, CET/CEST (Central European Time/Central European Summer Time).
   

  





**Om anställningen**




 Anställningen gäller tillsvidare, dock längst två år
   

  





 En anställning som postdoktor är en tidsbegränsad meriteringsanställning med huvudinriktning mot forskning avsedd som ett första karriärsteg efter disputation.
   

  





**Övrigt**




 För information om behandling av personuppgifter i samband med rekrytering.
   

  





 Det kan förekomma att en anställning hos KTH är placerad i säkerhetsklass. Om så är fallet för just denna anställning görs en säkerhetsprövning av sökande i enlighet med säkerhetsskyddslagen (2018:585) efter samtycke. I dessa fall är en förutsättning för anställning att sökande blir godkänd efter säkerhetsprövning.
   

  





 Vi undanber oss direktkontakt med bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag samt försäljare av platsannonser.

title: Erfaren riskexpert - tillsyn av IKT-risker inom den finansiella sektorn
description:
Har du gedigen erfarenhet av IKT-risker och vill vara med och stärka motståndskraften i det finansiella systemet? På Finansinspektionen (FI) söker vi dig som vill bidra till att säkerställa att finansiella företag är motståndskraftiga och hanterar sina IKT-risker, ett avgörande arbete för att skydda samhällets finansiella infrastruktur. Har du erfarenhet av IKT-risker, cybersäkerhet eller informationssäkerhet? Då kan du bli vår nästa riskexpert och få möjlighet att påverka både nationellt och internationellt i en roll med stort samhällsansvar.
   

  

**Om jobbet**
 Som riskexpert på Resiliensavdelningen så analyserar och utvärderar du självständigt rapporter, incidenter och data från finansiella företag. Du leder undersökningar för att tillse att Dora-regelverket och andra relevanta regelverk med krav på IKT-riskhantering efterlevs och att finansiella företag är motståndskraftiga. Dessutom leder du arbetet med att bevaka och följa utvecklingen som sker inom cybersäkerhetsområdet och de risker som de finansiella företagen och det finansiella systemet i sin helhet är exponerade emot.
   

  

 Du får en central roll i att utveckla FI:s metoder, processer och analysförmåga inom tillsyn av cybersäkerhet och IKT-risker. Arbetet innebär nära samverkan med andra tillsynsmyndigheter, både nationellt och internationellt, samt dialog med finansiella företag och branschföreträdare, vilket ställer krav på gott omdöme och förmåga att kunna kommunicera tydligt med olika målgrupper.
   

  

 För att lösa vårt komplexa uppdrag krävs det ofta en mängd olika infallsvinklar och expertkunskap. Det gör att du arbetar tillsammans med och lär dig av ledande specialister inom en mängd olika områden samt delar med dig av din egen kunskap.
   

  

**Din utbildning och erfarenhet**
 Vi söker dig som har
   

  

* relevant akademisk utbildning inom till exempel juridik, ekonomi eller it/systemvetenskap/cybersäkerhet
* god kunskap om IKT-risker, informationssäkerhet och cybersäkerhet
* god kunskap om Dora-förordningen eller motsvarande regelverk inom operativ motståndskraft, informationssäkerhet eller cybersäkerhet
* erfarenhet av arbete med IKT-risker, informationssäkerhet, cybersäkerhet, riskhantering eller intern kontroll alternativt erfarenhet av att genomföra granskningar, riskbedömningar, revisioner eller kontroller
* erfarenhet av att analysera komplexa risk- och regelefterlevnadsfrågor samt omsätta dessa analyser i tydliga bedömningar och rekommendationer
* god kunskap i att uttrycka dig på svenska och engelska i tal och skrift.


 Det är meriterande om du har
   

  

* god kunskap om finansiella företag och det finansiella systemet i sin helhet samt de IKT-risker som dessa är exponerade mot
* erfarenhet av att arbeta med implementering, efterlevnad eller granskning av Dora-förordningen
* erfarenhet från tillsynsmyndighet, internrevision, externrevision eller annan kontrollfunktion
* erfarenhet av granskning och bedömning av IKT-riskhanteringsramverk, incidenthantering, kontinuitetshantering, tredjepartsriskhantering eller krisberedskap
* erfarenhet av att analysera tekniska rapporter, revisionsrapporter, penetrations- eller cybersäkerhetstester, incidentrapporter och riskanalyser
* god förståelse för tekniska miljöer och arkitekturer i finansiella system t.ex. molntjänster, tredjepartsleverantörer, kontinuitetslösningar eller incidenthantering.


**Om dig**
 I det här jobbet behöver du
   

  

* driva ditt arbete framåt och ta beslut inom ditt ansvarsområde
* ha en god analytisk förmåga och kunna lösa komplexa uppgifter
* ta egna initiativ

title: Inköpare för UBW Inköp support
description:
**Vi söker en Inköpare för UBW Inköp support till ett företag i Stockholm (Sundbyberg). Start är i december eller januari. Detta är ett 2 års tidsbegränsat uppdrag till att börja med - möjlighet till förlängning efter det.** 




  





**Bakgrund/Uppdragsbeskrivning** 




 Kundens inköpsavdelning består av ca 50 medarbetare som arbetar främst med verksamhetens behov av upphandlingar och avrop från ramavtal. Vi har även en supporterande roll vid mindre inköp som verksamhetens sköter själva. Denna supporterande roll som vi nu söker en resurskonsult för innebär ett operativt arbete genom hela processen "Inköp till betalning" genom kanaler som e-post, Skype och telefon.
 



 Affärssystemet vi använder i dagsläget är Unit4 ERP - UBW. Många delar i processen inom systemet är administrativt utmanande för sällananvändare, så konsultens roll är att handgripligen hjälpa samt guida för att genomföra inköpet korrekt och så smidigt som möjligt. Du måste därför ha lätt för att förstå systems uppbyggnad och flöden.
 



 Många lathundar, guider och instruktioner finns men i takt med förändring kan behov finnas för uppdatering och utveckling av nya instruktioner. Rollen innebär nära samarbete med verksamheten, inköpsfunktionen, ekonomifunktionen och systemförvaltningen.
 



 Du tillhör en av fyra inköpsenheter med ca 20 kollegor. Rollen som Inköpare för UBW Inköp support är den enda inom gruppen, men med stöd och nära samarbete med system- och applikationsansvarig för UBW Inköp.
 



  





 Då uppdraget fokuserar på snabb hantering av beställarnas behov är det viktigt att du är serviceinriktad och gillar att hjälpa till. Det kan stundtals vara ett högt arbetstempo med många ärenden. Då gäller det att behålla lugnet, kunna prioritera och beta av.
 



 För kännedom så börjar nu ett arbete med att se över framtidens behov av inköpssystem och under 2027 och 2028 kommer upphandling och implementering av nytt inköpssystem implementeras. Upphandlingar hos kunden genomförs enligt LUF, Lagen om offentlig upphandling inom försörjningssektorerna. Det är viktigt att du har förståelse och agerar utifrån våra interna principer och riktlinjer samt lagkrav för hur inköp i verksamheten får gå till.
 



  





**I uppdraget ingår följande arbetsuppgifter:** 




 • Operativt stöd till användare i hela processen: Inköp till betalning
 



 • Skapa artiklar och inköpsorder.
 



 • Hantering av ärenden och frågor kopplade till beställningar, leverantörer och fakturor via email, Skype, telefon och fysiska möten.
 



 • Administrativt stöd inom inköpsområdet.
 



 • Uppföljning och koordinering av operativa inköpsrelaterade aktiviteter.
 



 • Stöd vid utbildning och introduktion av användare.
 



 • Samverkan med systemförvaltning och supportfunktion vid incidenter och
 



 förbättringsbehov.
 



 • Bidra till att säkerställa att processer och arbetssätt fungerar i den dagliga verksamheten.
 



 • Guida och hjälpa till med avtal, artiklar, rekvisitioner, inköporder och registrering av ärendet
 



 • Löpande svarar på frågor och hjälpa beställare från verksamheten i deras användande av
 



 systemet.
 



 • Viss kontakt med leverantörer för att guida dem i våra processer och tillvägagångssätt
 



 • Hantering av masterdata och registrering
 



  





**Obligatoriska krav:** 




 1. Du ska ha högskole/universitetsexamen inom något av följande ämnen: Ekonomi,
 



 teknik, juridik, beteendevetenskap, alternativt YH-utbildning inom inköp eller motsvarande
 



 relevant utbildning som Svenska Kraftnät bedömer likvärdigt för uppdraget.
 



 2. Du ska ha minst 3 års arbetslivserfarenhet av att ha arbetat inom operativt inköp.
 



 3. Du ska ha minst 3 års arbetslivserfarenhet av att ha arbetat operativt inom hela
 



 processen: Inköp till faktura (P2P)
 



 4. Du ska ha minst 2 års arbetslivserfarenhet av att ha arbetat administrativt i
 



 affärssystem.
 



 5. Du ska ha minst 2 års arbetslivserfarenhet av att ha arbetat som användarstöd eller
 



 inom en supportfunktion.
 



 6. Du ska kunna kommunicera obehindrat i svenska i både tal och skrift.
 



  





**Meriterande:** 




 1. Du bör ha minst 2 års arbetslivserfarenhet inom affärssystemet UNIT 4 ERP- UBW
 



 2. Du bör ha minst 2 års arbetslivserfarenhet inom offentlig verksamhet
 



 3. Du bör ha minst 2 års arbetslivserfarenhet inom e-handel eller beställningssystem
 



 4. Du bör ha minst 2 års arbetslivserfarenhet inom fakturahantering
 



  





**Säkerhetsprövning:** 
 Säkerhetsprövning och registerkontroll krävs.
 



  





**Preliminärt startdatum** 
 : 2026-12-01 eller absolut senast 2027-01-11, alternativt så snart säkerhetsprövning och registerkontroll är klar.
 



**Slutdatum** 
 : 2028-11-30
 



  





 Detta är ett konsultuppdrag på heltid 100% via Incluso i Stockholm (Sundbyberg).Det här uppdraget är ca 75% on-site i Sundbyberg - 25% can vara remote.
 



  





 Vänligen sök med CV och motivering via länken nedan. Vi presenterar kandidater löpande.

 *2026-09-01* 
 (kl 15.00)**

title: Sr. GTM Specialist Solution Architect GenAI, EU North, EMEA Data and AI Solutions Architecture
description:
**Description**
 AWS Specialist Solutions Architects (SSAs) are technologists with deep domain-specific expertise, able to address advanced concepts and feature designs. As part of the AWS sales organization, SSAs work with customers who have complex challenges that require expert-level knowledge to solve. SSAs craft scalable, flexible, and resilient technical architectures that address those challenges. This might involve guiding customers as they refactor an application or designing entirely new cloud-based system Specialist SAs play a critical role in capturing customer feedback, advocating for roadmap enhancements, and anticipating customer requirements as they work backwards from their needs. As domain experts, SSAs also participate in field engagement and enablement, producing content such as whitepapers, blogs, and workshops for customers, partners, and the AWS Technical Field.
   

  

 AI/ML/GenAI Specialist Solutions Architects combine technical skills in AI/ML/GenAI business acumen, and technical sales skills. They are focused on supporting customers throughout the engagement lifecycle and work closely with the teams that support implementation including AWS Professional Services and Partners. SSAs unblock customers and help them get to production faster. Joining AWS as a Specialist Solutions Architect will give you opportunities to work on interesting and challenging problems, collaborate with a group of skilled practitioners focused on delivering outcomes for our customers, and be part of a diverse and inclusive community committed to being Earth’s Best Employer.
   

  

 AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 The WWSO AI/ML/GenAI Specialist SA team builds technical relationships with customers of all sizes and operate as their trusted advisor, ensuring they get the most out of the cloud at every stage of their journey while adopting GenAI/ML and Agentic technologies across their organisation.
   

  

 You’ll manage the overall technical relationship between AWS and our customers, making recommendations on security, cost, performance, reliability and operational efficiency to accelerate their challenging GenAI/ML and Agentic projects.
   

  

 Internally, you will be the voice of the customer, sharing their needs with regard to their usage of our services impacting the roadmap of AWS GenAI/ML and Agentic features.
   

  

 In this role, your creativity will link technology to tangible solutions, with the opportunity to define cloud-native GenAI/ML and Agentic architectural patterns for a variety of use cases.
   

  

 You will participate in the creation and sharing of best practices, technical content and new reference architectures (e.g. white papers, code samples, blog posts) and evangelize and educate about running GenAI/ML and Agentic workloads on AWS technology (e.g. through workshops, user groups, meetups, public speaking, online videos or conferences).
   

  

 If you can educate AWS customers about the art of the possible, while challenging the impossible, come build the future with us.

 EMEA SSAs are part of the Worldwide Specialist Organization (WWSO) which builds and executes go-to-market plans that turn AWS ideas into multi-billion-dollar businesses.  Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for experienced and motivated technologists who possess a unique balance of technical depth and strong interpersonal skills. You will partner some of the worlds largest Automotive and Manufacturing companies, to craft highly scalable, flexible and resilient cloud architectures that address customer business problems and accelerate the adoption of AWS services. In collaboration with account managers, you will assist in driving growth across a set of global customers in your defined country.  Be great fun to work with.

description:

Our product portfolio primarily consists of software solutions developed in-house, complemented by proprietary hardware and selected commercial off-the-shelf components. The breadth of the role offers a unique opportunity to work across multiple disciplines and gain a deep understanding of complex systems. You will also have opportunities to travel and engage directly with customers across the globe.


Building strong relationships with customers, end users, sales teams and other stakeholders is an important part of the role. By understanding customer needs and translating them into robust technical solutions, you will contribute directly to creating products that meet the highest standards of quality, safety and performance.


You will join an international team of Product System Engineers and subject matter experts located in Växjö and Gothenburg, Sweden, and Apeldoorn, the Netherlands. The position can be based in any of these locations. Together, we foster a supportive and inclusive environment where teamwork, continuous learning and personal growth are encouraged.


Information about some of the innovative products we develop and deliver can be found using this link: https://www.saab.com/products/security/air-traffic-management.

We are looking for an experienced System Engineer who enjoys working with complex technology and collaborating with others to solve meaningful challenges. You likely have at least three years of relevant experience and hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Software Engineering or a related field.


We believe you bring experience, knowledge or a strong interest in one or more of the following areas:

* Complex software-intensive systems and hardware solutions
* Real-time, regulated or safety-critical systems
* Cyber security and secure system design


Experience within Air Traffic Management is considered an advantage, but it is not a requirement.


To succeed in this role, you are structured and able to balance multiple priorities while maintaining a clear focus on quality and delivery. You are comfortable navigating change and enjoy finding practical, creative solutions to new challenges. Just as importantly, you are a collaborative team player who values different perspectives and contributes to a positive and inclusive working environment.


We also believe that you are curious by nature and motivated by continuous learning, whether that means deepening your technical expertise or broadening your understanding of customer needs and business objectives.


Strong communication skills in English, both written and spoken, are essential. A valid driver's license is considered an advantage.

*This position requires that you pass a security vetting based on the current regulations around/of security protection. For positions requiring security clearance additional obligations on citizenship may apply.*

### **What you will be a part of**


Explore a wealth of possibilities. Take on challenges, create smart inventions, and grow beyond. This is a place for curious minds, brave pioneers, and everyone in between. Together, we achieve the extraordinary, each bringing our unique perspectives. Your part matters.


Saab is a leading defense and security company with an enduring purpose, to help nations keep their people and society safe. Empowered by its 28,000 talented people, Saab constantly pushes the boundaries of technology to create a safer and more sustainable world.


Saab designs, manufactures and maintains advanced systems in aeronautics, weapons, command and control, sensors and underwater systems. Saab is headquartered in Sweden. description:
**Job Title**
-------------


Experienced Software Test Engineer - Analytics Test, Lund**Job Description**
-------------------

*Are you an experienced test engineer fascinated by computer vision and the unique challenges of testing AI? Do you want to play a key role in ensuring the quality of cutting-edge software? Join our dynamic Quality Assurance team in Lund and help us shape the future of intelligent video solutions.*

**Who is your future team?**
----------------------------


Join our Analytics Test team, a collaborative and dynamic group focused on delivering high-quality video analytics software. We work closely with development teams and product management to verify new features and applications.


Our team is all about responsibility, creativity, and collaboration. We trust each other to take ownership of our work and share knowledge freely. While we take our quality goals seriously, we also believe in having fun along the way and maintaining an informal, supportive atmosphere. If you're looking for a team that is self-sufficient, innovative, and deeply passionate about technology, you will feel right at home.

**What will you do as an Experienced Software Test Engineer?**
--------------------------------------------------------------


In this role, your primary focus will be on driving test automation and securing the quality of our advanced video analytics and AI software. Testing AI introduces distinct paradigms compared to traditional software: while structured validation and automated regression testing remain vital, you must also navigate the probabilistic nature of machine learning models.


### **Your tasks will include:**

* Designing, developing, and executing strategies to test complex AI functionality, understanding how neural networks behave, the critical impact of training and test data, and applying a scientific and statistical approach to validation.
* Developing and maintaining robust test automation frameworks, test environments, and CI/CD integrations.
* Implementing both functional and non-functional test cases (manual and automated) tailored to computer vision and video analytics.
* Providing support and sharing your expertise with colleagues looking to implement automation and advanced testing practices.
* Analyzing logs, test metrics, and performance results to troubleshoot and verify bug fixes.
* Collaborating directly with developers, users, and stakeholders to understand emerging AI technologies and requirements.

**Who are we looking for?**
---------------------------


We are looking for an experienced and self-driven engineer with a strong technical background and a genuine interest in software quality and artificial intelligence. You possess a scientific and analytical mindset, understanding what separates AI testing from traditional software testing as well as what remains the same. You are proactive, take responsibility, and genuinely enjoy collaborating and sharing knowledge.

### **We'd love to hear that you have:**

* A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related technical field.
* Solid professional experience in software testing, test automation, and test framework development.
* A strong grasp of AI and machine learning concepts—specifically how AI models and neural networks work, the importance of data quality/diversity, and statistical approaches to evaluating model performance.
* Strong programming skills with very good knowledge of Python (experience with pytest is a strong plus), alongside familiarity with other programming and scripting languages.
* Practical experience working in a Linux environment, version control (GIT), APIs, databases, and CI/CD contexts (such as Jenkins and Docker).

At its core, leadership is about more than just managing others - it's about taking initiative and driving change. We are a world leader in network video, where cutting-edge technology meets global impact. Here, you’ll contribute to meaningful projects that shape the future of security and surveillance — developing solutions used worldwide. As a fast-growing company, we offer exciting career opportunities.
